articleTitle: Simultaneous Application of Several Synthetic Methods for High Efficiency Radiofrequency Amplification
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To achieve high efficiency while amplifying modern signals with a high crest factor, switching operating modes of transistors and synthetic amplification methods are used. The most promising of these are Kahn method (EER-Envelope Elimination and Restoration) and outphasing method. However, these methods have a number of limitations, to overcome which the possibilities of joint simultaneous application of several synthetic methods of radio frequency amplification are considered. To simultaneous application the outphasing method with bridge power combiner and power supply voltage pulse-step modulation, the dependence of average efficiency on number of supply voltage levels is determined. For EER amplifier, minimum required pulse width of PWM modulator is determined depending on the RF bandwidth of amplified signal and its dynamic range. Variants of these characteristics exchange for the number of supply voltage levels are discussed when pulse-step modulation is used together. Directions for further research formulated.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network Based Angle-of-Arrival Estimator
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper reviews a subset of approaches to the angle-of-arrival problem that can be redefined in a form compatible with the techniques based on artificial neural networks. That subset includes a step viewed as a mapping between a set of cross-delays and the estimated value of the angle of arrival. The paper demonstrates artificial neural networks to be a suitable solution to the particular part of a problem. The conventional multilayer perceptron and specialized angular network topologies are presented to emphasize the essential step of first considering a prior knowledge of the problem while synthesizing and training a network. The numerical simulation results including the plot of the loss function and the trainable parameters gradients during the training process are presented for both models. The results indicate that the angular model appears to be superior to the conventional one. Additional note and simulation for the angular model is performed to reveal the generalization ability of a properly trained neural network. This makes it possible for the network to withstand a certain level of noise that contaminates the input data. Some important points, which left outside of the scope of the main part of the article, and key points for further research are highlighted in the conclusion.

articleTitle: The Method and Devices for Research the Parameters of the Human Visual System to Video Quality Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The susceptibility of distortions introduced by compression from the point of view of human perception is an important area of research. The ultimate purpose of video quality assessment is to emulate the performance of the biological visual system. Perceptual distortion models have proven successful in describing spatial coding in all human visual systems. However, the question of how the visual regions of the human brain process temporal information have received significantly less attention. Based on the researches of limit to human vision, here we offer a method, software, and test equipment for research and measure the characteristics of human visual systems. This set forms and evaluates stimuli with a specified combination of spatial, temporal, and color characteristics, which differ in a narrowband enough spectrum for measurements.

articleTitle: On-board Transmission Quality Assessment Using Short Audio Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, there is no method for assessing the quality of information audio signal transmission over the transmission channel. According to Russian National Standard (GOST), simple stationary test signals should be used for channel evaluation. II additional processing devices should be disabled, while test signal is applied. Compact representation of signal and it's effect of signal quality are ignored. Based on the results of the research carried out by the authors, it is possible to determine the relationship between the change in a number of objective parameters and the subjective quality assessment from real listeners.

articleTitle: Laser Controlled Loop Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A new type of antenna system has been proposed - a configurable loop antenna with laser control. It is shown that the addition of semiconductor elements of the photoresistor type to the elements of the outer contour of the loop antenna makes it possible to significantly expand the functionality of the loop antenna and control the antenna characteristics using an external laser source. The paper presents the results of studies of characteristics of the transmission coefficient S11 of loop antennas composed of metal and semiconductor elements. It has been found that when a semiconductor element (photoresistor) is exposed to laser radiation, it is possible to effectively control the wave impedance of the antenna. In the range 0.3-800 MHz, the dependences of the voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) and impedance on the radiation power of the laser module are obtained.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Traffic Balancing for Data Centers Serving Requests of LEO Mobile Satellite Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the features of low earth orbit (LEO) mobile satellite systems is to deliver information to the data analytic centers. Many types of alarm information are collected by smart meters and video cameras that are placed where wired telecommunication is not possible due to the technical or economic meanings. It is supposed that requests for servicing are arriving to the data center following the Poisson model and each requiring exponentially distributed computing time. A data center consists of some number of computing units. Each unit processes the requests according to the Processor Sharing (PS) service discipline and cannot accept at the same time more than fixed number of requests. The mathematical model of load balancing between computing units is constructed. Two scenarios are considered: “static” when requests are routed to computing units according to the prescribed probabilities and “greedy” when requests are routed to the least loaded computing unit. Using the model, the main performance measures of interest are given with help of values of probabilities of model's stationary states. The recursive algorithm of performance measures estimation is suggested. The model and derived algorithms can be used for study the scenarios of traffic balancing at the data analytic centers.

articleTitle: Cramer-Rao Bounds for Wideband Signal Parameters Joint Estimation in Ionospheric Frequency Dispersion Distortion Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Analytical expressions for the Cramer-Rao boundaries are obtained in the article when jointly evaluating a set of parameters for a broadband ionospheric-distorted signal of an arbitrary shape, namely: the steepness of the dispersion characteristic, Doppler frequency shift, delay and phase shift. The corresponding expressions for covariance functions and correlation coefficients are obtained. It is shown that the presence of dispersion distortions leads to additional, previously absent, statistical relationships of estimates of signal parameters. The correctness of analytical expressions is confirmed by the results of simulation. The reported study was funded by RFBR, project number 19-29-06055.

articleTitle: Refining Time Delay Estimate of Complex Signal Using Polynomial Interpolation in Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper deals with time delay estimation of a complex random signal carried out in the time domain where its discrete-time finite observation is being processed. The paper observes polynomial interpolation methods applied to a sampled cross-correlation function (CCF) in the neighborhood of its maximum. This kind of approximation compromises the fast computation of the delay with the high accuracy of resultant estimate. The second and third order polynomial approximation schemes are considered for three approaches based on absolute value of correlation samples or their complex originals. The latter is shown to be obligatory forced with the condition that time delay estimate has to be real-valued despite the fact that complex signals are processed. The numerical simulation performed for first-order autoregressive model random process allows estimating the dependency of the bias, variance and total error of the estimates on signal-to-noise ratio. The comparative analysis conducted for the methods shows that second-order approximation applied to absolute value of CCF produce the accuracy that can be treated as satisfactory for general purpose.

articleTitle: Fraction-of- Time Density Estimation Based on Linear Interpolation of Time Series
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A new estimator for the probability density function of a signal observed over a finite observation interval is proposed. The estimator linearly interpolates adjacent samples and accommodates the presence of probability masses. The analysis is carried out in the fraction-of-time (FOT) probability framework where signals are modeled as single functions of time rather than sample paths of a stochastic process. Numerical results show the better performance of the proposed estimator with respect to the kernel-based estimator. Moreover, the usefulness of analyzing signals in the FOT framework is enlightened.

articleTitle: Establishment of Estimated Parameters Limits for On-Board Radio Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we discuss the problem of establishment of estimated parameters limits for on-board radio electronic equipment. An indicator of compliance with a multi-parameter electronic equipment is proposed, based on minimizing the dimension of the vector of parameters that directly determine the objective function, approximating the tolerance region by hyperplanes, taking into account changes in parameters during operation. The correspondence indicator has the form of a hyperparallelepiped, and when assessing the correspondence, both the location of the point of the state space inside the parallelepiped and the distance from the point of the state space to the reference plane (the face of the hyperparallelepiped) can be determined. The example of using the developed indicator for analyzing the movement of an aircraft in an air corridor is proposed.

articleTitle: Features of Converting Signals to Binary and Minimizing Distortion
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A well-known complex of methods for converting signals into binary digital form is shown, potential theoretically achievable boundaries of such conversions are determined. Values are calculated that indicate the value of the code distance between the original values and those obtained after transformation. Euclidean space metric. A correspondence is established between these messages and binary code combinations in the Hamming space. It is proved that in some cases the values that determine the distance between messages and the metric are quite general and should be clarified for specific situations. Distortion minimization is suitable for cases where the minimum code distances of the primary metric space are related to the minimum code distances of the secondary metric space. And also in the article the admissible limits of such minimization are found.

articleTitle: Testing Procedures and Certification of Highly Automated and Autonomous Road Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article is dedicated to the analysis of existing regulatory and legal acts in the field of regulating the use and testing of highly automated and autonomous vehicles in the EU, USA, and Russia. The statistical information of road accidents relevant for the Russian conditions is presented for the purpose of localizing the critical test scenarios. The results of virtual tests of pedestrian protection system (PPS) conducted in Siemens Prescan software for different weather and lighting conditions are presented, as well as some other practical cases of advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) simulation.

articleTitle: Investigating a Miniaturization Approach for Power Dividers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the miniaturization of directional couplers assembled on original artificial transmission lines. The topology of a compact device operating at a frequency of 0.9 GHz is obtained. The substrate material is the Rogers R003 widely used for these devices. The compact device has an area of only 855.6 mm2, which is 74.2% less than a traditional device operating at the same frequency.

articleTitle: Investigation of Corporate Networks with Moving Objects Using Combined Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The development of algorithms for the neural network approach and the use of monitoring and management of corporate communication networks is considered as the creation and management of new types of services in networks, which is an urgent task for modern corporations. This, in turn, also influenced the elements of the modern world, which are in constant motion or do not have constant locations. To achieve that goal, it is necessary to create algorithms for actions to improve the efficiency of building and automating the processes of creating and improving mobile corporate networks. An important task is to provide examples of corporate networks with the presented domains, taking into account their fragments. Depending on the type of fragment and its purpose, their differences are shown. The proposed method makes it possible to increase the efficiency of optimization as a procedure for choosing the optimal technological conditions for the functioning of a corporate network, indicating the high quality of all its components.

articleTitle: Implementation of an Algorithm for Intelligent Tuning of Operating Frequencies for Cognitive Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the issues of practical implementation of the previously developed algorithms for intelligent tuning of operating frequencies in cognitive radio systems. Two SDR devices of the LimeSDR type were used as a model of the cognitive radio system. An OFDM signal with an adaptive signal-code structure is used as a system signal. Service information about the parameters of the signal-code structure and the number of the frequency channel of the next frame is transmitted in the pilot signal subcarriers. To implement the algorithm, special software has been developed. Experimental studies were carried out with the use of software, where it was shown that the use of an algorithm for predicting the occupancy of frequency channels can reduce the time of operational scanning of the spectrum.

articleTitle: Stagnation in the Development of Internal Combustion Engines as a Factor of Transition to More Perfect Power Units
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article analyzes trends in the design of car engines. It assesses the impact of modern engine designs on the economic safety and efficiency of automobiles. The authors provide a combined graph of changes in the design of internal combustion engines over the past 30 years, which shows that their further development is stalling, indicating stagnation. The article also analyzes the impact of improved environmental friendliness on design complexity and reliability. As a result of the analysis, it has been found that the maintenance of the technical condition of an engine is becoming more and more expensive. This inevitably increases the number of defective vehicles in operation with poor environmental performance. The results of comparing normative and actual emissions also confirm this. This article compares the aggregate environmental emissions from vehicles with different engine types at all stages of their life cycle, which shows the prospects for the development of hybrid vehicles. Comparison of fuel consumption of vehicles with both hybrid and gasoline engines of similar power, operated under the same conditions, is given by months during one year. According to the authors, the constant development of vehicle performance should inevitably lead to the natural emergence of radically new designs, which will have higher performance properties and will set the development of vehicle power units in the coming decades.

articleTitle: Research of the Hybrid Filter Bank Frequency Equalizer Transfer Function Coefficients Estimation Quality
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents a method for calculating the quality of the estimation of the filter coefficients of the corrector of a hybrid filter bank, based on the error of the indirect estimation of the amplitude and phase of the equalizer coefficients. To confirm the correctness of the theoretical expressions, a hybrid filter bank was simulated with the addition of white Gaussian noise in the calibration path at different SNR values.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Service Availability in Software-Defined Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The object of this study is services in a software-defined optical network (SDON). The subject of the study is flows of incoming calls and their indicators of quality of service in SDON. The purpose of this article is to study the possibility of providing a guaranteed data transmission rate to the client, depending on the parameters of the superchannel being created. The results obtained made it possible to reveal that the used number of optical subcarriers in the superchannel makes the greatest contribution to the probability of refusal in providing a service of a guaranteed data transmission rate. The methodological basis of the study is made up of the comparative and descriptive methods, the method of scientific experiment and the method of generalization. On the basis of the conducted scientific experiments conclusions are made and recommendations are worked out.

articleTitle: Experience of Using a Moving Pedestrian Model in Tests of Automatic Emergency Braking System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article substantiates the necessity of testing modern electronic driver assistance systems. The results of the experimental study of the performance of the automatic emergency braking system (AEBS) are presented. The study was conducted with the help of the developed movable model of an adult pedestrian. A traffic situation in which a pedestrian crosses the road in front of a car is simulated. The test object is equipped with an AEBS with pedestrian collision prevention function, the vision organs are radar and video camera. The tests were conducted during the day and at night. The road surface was moistened asphalt. The process of “destruction” of the layout during collision is analyzed. Parametric records of the test runs are presented. The functionality of the AEBS actuation is defined.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of Controlled Discrete-Nonlinear Dmitriev-Kislov System by Fractional Power Spectra
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The features of diagnostics of a controlled multimode discrete-nonlinear Dmitriev-Kislov system based on the non-harmonic spectra of the generated signals are considered. Serial and parallel analyzers of fractional-power spectra based on selective suppression of signal components using fractional order differentiation and integration are proposed and compared. The multidimensional non-harmonic fractional-power spectra of signals of the discrete-nonlinear Dmitriev-Kislov system are investigated. An approach has been developed in the diagnostics of a controlled discrete-nonlinear system Dmitriev-Kislov, modified by control actions on the parameters of time sampling, based on fractional-power spectra of the generated 3-D signals.

articleTitle: Networks Modernization Using SDN and NFV Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Network modernization using software-defined networks (SDN) technology and network functions virtualization (NFV) involves the use of a unified physical infrastructure, based on which various applications that implement all possible network functions operate. The explosive growth of mobile devices and content, as well as virtualization and the emergence of cloud services, is forcing the network industry to rethink traditional architectures. In networks with SDN architecture, the network industry is actively developing OpenFlow Protocol to provide communication between the control layer (SDN controllers) and data transfer devices (SDN switches). This article offers possibilities for modernization optical networks using various options for implementing SDN/NFV technologies.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Impact of Random Distribution Laws on the Characteristics of On-Board Service Using Queuing Models
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Ground handling is part of the work process of any onboard complex. The article presents a model of the process of such service, based on the queuing theory methods. The model based on the assumption that random values describing these processes may have arbitrary distributions, which in turn affects the quality of board service. Differences in the values of quality indicators can reach in the case of different distribution laws, they can differ by an order of magnitude, which can be of significant importance when deciding on the deployment of the next point of on-board service. The fundamental importance has that are investigated not the average values of service quality indicators, but their maximum values, which are guaranteed for a predetermined proportion of the entire flow of boards arriving for service.

articleTitle: Combined Precoding Tehcnique with Antenna Selection for Massive MU-MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Frequency plan of the new standard of mobile communication systems 5G New Radio contain a large number of time division duplex bands. At the same time number of antennas in MIMO systems increases at the both sides on base station and on user equipment. The main goal of new technologies applying is to achieve high throughput according new enhanced mobile broadband scenarios: eMBB, uRLLC, mMTC. There are a lot of different methods for spatially signals processing, including precoding, beamforming, space-time codes, antenna selection. We proposed combined precoding technique with antenna selection, based on channel reciprocity principle, implemented in frequency bands with TDD mode. Proposed precoding technique with antenna selection can significantly increase the energy efficiency of multi-antenna systems with antenna configurations of the considered type, where user equipment has a large number of antennas. In addition, the proposed precoding algorithm has a low computational complexity and does not require the high efficiency feedback channel.

articleTitle: Problemic Issues of Deploying Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems During of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the problematic issues of the development of intelligent transport systems and the deployment of cooperative intelligent transport systems, taking into account the issues of ensuring the safety of critical infrastructures during digital transformation. Attention is paid to terminology as an effective means of bringing together the opinions of specialists from interdependent but in fact weakly interacting areas of knowledge, as well as a strategy for digital transformation.

articleTitle: Providing Additional Situational Awareness with the Use of V2X Technology to Improve the Reliability of Highly Automated Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers an experiment on the formation of the movement of highly automated vehicles on public roads with additional situational awareness. The results of the experiment are presented on the basis of which the effectiveness of the digital model of the road and elements of the intelligent road infrastructure for ensuring road traffic safety in accordance with the “Concept for ensuring road safety with the participation of unmanned vehicles on public roads” is assessed.

articleTitle: Creation of a Certification System for Ensuring the Safety of Information Transfer Between Vehicles and Intelligent Road Infrastructure in the Russian Federation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the structure of the national ITS network and the formation of the structure of the certification system in the Russian Federation. To ensure the proper level of information and cybersecurity of intelligent transport systems and intelligent road infrastructure, including in matters of depersonalization of personal data of users, a system for issuing security certificates should be built. Ensuring the security of data transmission while ensuring the operation of ITS is the most important task when implementing new technologies and services. To ensure the control of the relevance of certificates of compliance with the level of ensuring the safety of equipment and technological processes in ITS, it is necessary to form a national structure for issuing safety certificates.

articleTitle: Quality Management in the Automotive Industry in the Digital Transformation Era
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents the results of the development of the concept of a digital quality management system in the automotive industry. The transition, in the context of logistics cooperation of assembly production, to the digitalization of quality management and monitoring processes is based on a system of data collection and intelligent processing at key stages of the production process. Equipping with digital tools, switching from defect indices to performance quality indices. Digital transformation of production quality management using statistical tools, probabilistic modeling, logistics, as well as real production process indices. Creating models based on the definition of the most important technical characteristics with integration into the management system, taking into account the efficiency and flexibility of control actions.

articleTitle: Modeling of Fuel Consumption of Passenger Cars Based on Their Technical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents a mathematical model for determining the fuel consumption of passenger cars, using a minimum number of specifications and operating conditions. Fuel consumption rates declared by vehicle manufacturers differ significantly from experienced operating data, and this leads both to additional financial costs and to incorrect assessment of environmental damage. Existing methods of modeling vehicle fuel consumption in operation that use telematics data require pre-calibration of the equipment. Models based on them are difficult to use because of the large number of parameters. It is proposed to simulate the fuel efficiency of cars only on the basis of its technical characteristics, as well as the average speed of travel. For this purpose, experimental data on the movement of 796 passenger cars were used. The data were obtained during the operation of cars in the European part of Russia during 2017-2019. Based on the data obtained, a mathematical regression model has been built. It is shown that the application of the resulting fuel consumption model only on the basis of changes in average speed allows one to achieve accuracy acceptable for practical use in the case of passenger cars. The modeling error does not exceed 2.97%. The model does not use data on vehicle load, climate and road conditions and still gives reliable values in the case of passenger cars of B and C class.

articleTitle: Modeling and Comparison of Trajectory Filtering Algorithms in MLAT Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this article, an algorithm for determining RRS coordinates on the basis of Extended Kalman Filter with the processing of Time of Arrival (ToA) type measurements is proposed. The feature of the proposed algorithm is to determine the radio radiation source (RRS) time of transmission (ToT) in the MLAT system time scale and its filtration using priori information about the period of transmission. It's shown that evaluation of ToT and its filtration at a known period allows you to get closer to the accuracy provided by Time Of Fligth (ToF) method, which can not be implemented directly for MLAT systems. This hypothesis was confirmed by modeling several algorithms: one-step TDoA, filtered TDoA, filtered ToA and one-step ToF. Modeling was performed for both the known constant period and the non constant period. In both cases, the efficiency of the proposed ToA-F algorithm was the same. The efficiency of various algorithms was compared, including the traditional ones based on the calculation of arrival time differences and the proposed one based on ToA observations and using information about transmission period. The most important result was that the ToT estimation and filtering allows to achieve the properties of the ToF method in the MLAT system.

articleTitle: Ground Urban Passenger Transport in a Period of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the impact of digital technologies to improve the efficiency and quality of passenger transportation on urban ground passenger transport. The impact of new requirements to the organization of the transportation process and the role of data enrichment from different automated systems to create new services for all consumers are considered. The preconditions and practical deviations influence examples in individual subsystems on complex performance indicators are considered. Transport planning role, instrumental methods of collecting information in problem solving of increasing land-based urban passenger transport efficiency is shown. It is shown that an important element of digital transformation is route spatial digital model creation of urban passenger transport, an analytical description of track of the route, which is used in process of vehicles movement operational control. The influence of instrumental methods use of obtaining information on social standards observance for transport services quality is described. Goals and objectives of dispatching control and management of routed traffic are described, the main of which are deviation operational recording of actual traffic from the planned one, preventing an increase in traffic intervals, irregular runs, runs disruptions and consequences eliminating of violations and deviations. The role of transport services social standard for population, approved by the Ministry of Transport of Russia, in the transportation implementation of passengers and luggage by automobile transport and urban land electric transport is described.

articleTitle: Evaluation Methodology of Distribution of Vehicle Lane-change Probabilities on Multilane Road before Crossroad
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: We have developed a methodology that allows to develop recommendations for choosing a place to start lane changing with the intention to make a turn at a crossroad and choosing the duration of traffic light phases, and these durations may vary depending on the time of day. This methodology could be made on the basis of field measurements and a mathematical model of the traffic flow on a section of a multi-lane highway. There are actual to use Smart Light in ITS to control traffic on crossroads and to optimize the choice of traffic light phase durations. The developed model allows to calculate the distribution of traffic intensities on a section of a multi-lane highway. To verify and calibrate the model the distribution of traffic intensities has been calculated for a section of Leningradsky prospect, Moscow. The results of these measurements were compared with data obtained in measurements on the section. The model is based on the deterministic-stochastic control for traffic modeling in accordance of that the traffic flow is represented as the sum of the deterministic and stochastic components. The deterministic component corresponds to the velocity of a lattice movement, and the stochastic component corresponds to the velocity of the average particle movement. Using the deterministic-stochastic approach, we can obtain more exact evaluations of traffic characteristics.

articleTitle: Reflexive Control of Data Transmission in the Human-Machine Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the principle of reflexive control in relation to the design of the human-machine interface in vehicles with different levels of automation. The principle of information processing and decision-making by the driver in the "D-A-R" system is considered, as well as the mathematical apparatus of the decision-making process in reflexive reasoning and an example of the corresponding reflexive control is given.

Author Keywords: vehicle with different levels of automation

articleTitle: Methodological Approaches to Estimation of the Braking Energy Recovery Properties
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses methodological approaches to assessing the regenerative braking of a vehicle. The main approaches to the efficiency of recuperation from the point of view of the relativity of the returned and consumed energy are presented. A test procedure is presented on a laboratory setup consisting of an internal combustion engine, a generator, a traction electric motor, a capacitor energy storage unit, a load simulation unit and a control and measurement system. Measurements and recording of currents and voltages were carried out using the L-Card system. The motion control of the laboratory hybrid setup was carried out using the CX-Drive software. The authors present the results of laboratory tests of recuperation. Studies have been carried out to assess the properties of energy recovery in road conditions on a serial hybrid vehicle. The integral values were used to determine the maximum and average braking regenerative power, as well as the energy recovered during the test. The results of evaluating the efficiency of recuperation for movement in urban conditions are presented. During the tests, braking was carried out at a speed of 44 km/h. The research results allow us to conclude about the efficiency of recuperation. A comparison is made between laboratory and road tests of energy recovery. The materials presented by the authors expand the existing methodology for assessing the performance properties of regenerative braking of vehicles with hybrid and all-electric motors.

articleTitle: Optical Vector Analyzers for Multiplicative Fiber Optic Sensors Probing. Formulation of the Problem
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents the prerequisites for the use of polyharmonic microwave photonic vector analyzers for probing multiplicative sensors based on fiber Bragg structures in order to improve the metrological characteristics of systems for complex monitoring of technically complex objects.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Use of Service Level Agreement for Operators of Transport Systems and On-Board Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Fiber-optic communication lines are the basis of telecommunication networks. If at the initial stage of the development of optical communication FOCLs were laid only on transport networks, then as this type of communication develops, there is a transition to fiber-optic technology in intra-facility, including on-board systems. Today, the demand for traffic transmission is constantly growing, which leads to an increase in the amount and speed of transmitted information. Fiber outages result in poor communications, disrupt business processes, backorders, and dissatisfied customers. Even small communication downtime causes huge losses. The introduction of service quality categories will simplify the operation of transport systems and increase the economic efficiency of communication networks. However, this requires significant capital expenditures and annual operating costs, which do not always pay off by avoiding fiber downtime. A method for assessing the effectiveness of the use of a service level agreement (SLA) between an operator of a fiber-optic communication line (FOCL) and consumers of communication services is proposed. The net present value (NPV) is used as an indicator of efficiency; probabilistic characteristics are introduced. The calculation results and their brief analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling the Algorithm of Cumulative Sums in the Applied Problems of Detecting the Signals with Random Time of Occurrence in non-Gaussian Noise
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The methods of mathematical modeling of the cumulative sums algorithm in the problems of detecting signals with a random moment of occurrence in non-Gaussian noise are considered. The probability of false alarm errors and correct detection of imbalance based on the statistical characteristics of the algorithm of cumulative sums obtained by modeling real processes is calculated. An experimental distribution of the cumulative sum in state of imbalance at a current step for detection without reflecting or absorbing screens is obtained. A linear dependence between the means of the cumulative sum taken in separate sections is determined. Based on modeling real processes, the probability of correct detection and false alarm under the influence of non-Gaussian noise with a bimodal distribution is calculated. Effectiveness of cumulative sums algorithm both consistent and inconsistent with the density of the probability distribution of influencing noise is compared.

Author Keywords: a method of detecting imbalance of random processes
the probability of false alarm and correct detection

articleTitle: Connected Vehicle Remote Diagnostic System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a Connected Vehicle Remote Diagnostic System, designed for operational monitoring of the technical parameters of the vehicles systems in real time, from anywhere with a connection. This function is achieved by the fact that the data collection and transmission equipment is equipped with an adapter for monitoring the technical and operational parameters of vehicles and transmitting these parameters to the terminal device for subsequent sending to the telematic server, the adapter is connected to the CAN buses through the diagnostic connector in the vehicle and is coordinated with them on the software and hardware level. The system is designed to remotely communicate with owners and maintenance personnel to vehicle and provide vehicle warnings and information, including location, performance and service data, to make decisions about where and how the vehicle is used. The system provides critical system readings of temperature and pressure for specific vehicle functions, including hydraulic, transmission and cooling systems.

articleTitle: Method of Urban Traffic Management
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: As a result of the research carried out, it was found that when the weather conditions change, the mode of movement of traffic flows, namely the speed of movement, also changes. With the constant operation of the available technological equipment, which in turn is limited by such parameters as the intensity and composition of the traffic flow, this phenomenon leads to significant delays in traffic and often to the occurrence of road accidents. It is possible to establish a certain speed of movement when analyzing the condition of the roadway and determining its grip qualities, which are directly proportional. In the course of surveys in this direction, the relationship between the adhesion qualities of the pavement and weather conditions was determined, which became the basis for the algorithm that determines the required speed mode of movement. The implementation of the algorithm at the experimental city entrance made it possible to introduce the required speed mode and ensure the operation of the existing technological equipment taking it into account. Thus, within the framework of the study carried out, the authors propose an improved approach to the management of urban traffic flows, based on the regulation of the speed regime at the entrance to the city, taking into account the previously used characteristics - intensity and composition, and a previously unused indicator of weather conditions to ensure the operation of the existing technological equipment included into the ITS infrastructure.

articleTitle: Investigation of Stray Reflections in an Anechoic Chamber with Imaging Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The purpose of the work was to visualize the stray reflections in a large anechoic chamber. To assess the influence of multiple reflections caused by imperfect chamber design, a mathematical model of an idealized measurement procedure was developed. The novelty of the proposed study lies in usage of special diagrams that visualize the picture of measured distortions, which makes it possible to identify the most critical zones in terms of introduced errors within working area. All experiments were carried out with scanning, where the source antenna, representing the target, was moved on a plane relative to the receiving antenna that was tracking it. The obtained results reliably show the amplitude and phase errors over wide frequency band that manifest during measurements and are caused by stray reflections in the chamber. Imaging technique can become the basis for developing an error compensation scheme and improving the accuracy of testing process.

articleTitle: Reference Signal Compression in Intrusive Methods for Assessing the Quality of Speech Transmission Using the Unitary Numbering System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern quality control of speech transmission is based on the use of objective assessment methods. Intrusive methods are the most accurate, but they increase the load on the communication network. This is due to an estimation algorithm using a comparison of the corrupted communication channel and reference speech signals. The presentation of information in the unitary number system has significant redundancy compared to number systems with a larger base. In addition, it is distinguished by the presence of the same repeating characters. This allows information compression based on run length coding to be used. Translation of numbers between number systems, depending on their type, is carried out by the following main methods: direct replacement; sequential division based on the new number system. Hardware translation of numbers from binary to unitary number system is performed using decoders. The reverse hardware translation of numbers from a unitary number system to a binary one is carried out using scramblers. When storing data in unitary code, the required number of bits is determined by the size of the maximum data file and will not increase with the number of saved data files with a smaller size.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Subscriber Devices of Space Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article is devoted to the comparison of user devices from different manufacturers by their main characteristics. The devices of systems for various purposes are considered: meteorological, oceanographic, emergency rescue and fishing systems. To complete the picture, in addition to the currently operating systems without restrictions, the parameters of the system functional, which is currently limited - Argos, are given.

articleTitle: Estimation Method of v2v Networks Capacity in Saturated Traffic Flows
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers a traffic generated by messages that are sent by car drivers moving on a highway. The drivers exchange these messages (dedicated short-range communications) using the Wireless Access in Vehicular Environments (WAVE), IEEE 802.11p standard. The communication channels provide access to each other or to objects located on the same highway. A mathematical model is developed to estimate the capacity congestion of the mobile connection by which the messages are sent. The model provides estimates that are used to prescribe parameters of a queueing system. This queueing system is used to estimate the delays of the messages transitions. An approximate formula is proposed to compute the average sojourn time in this queueing system.

articleTitle: Detection of Signals with a Random Moment of Occurrence Using the Cumulative Sum Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A method for detecting signals with a random moment of occurrence based on the algorithm of cumulative sums with a reflecting screen under the influence of non-Gaussian noise is presented. An example of detecting a signal exposed to non-Gaussian quasi-deterministic additive noise is used for obtaining the dependences of the probability of false detection on the value of the signal-to-noise ratio for different values of the detection threshold. An increase in the detection threshold value, as well as the value of the signal-to-noise ratio, leads to a decrease in the probability of false detection. It is shown that the case of coordinated noise has the highest probability of correct detection. The algorithm for detecting a signal against the background of pulse noise and fluctuating non-Gaussian noise is analyzed and curves for probability of correct detection are obtained. It is found that the mismatch of the cumulative sum algorithm and the real density of probability distribution of noise leads to a decrease in the probability of correct detection. It is shown that the cumulative sum algorithm allows not only to solve the problem of detecting a signal in real time, but is also simple enough to be used when solving some practical problems.

articleTitle: Bit Error Rate Performance of Power Domain Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Article focuses at research Bit Error Rate (BER) for Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) infocommunication system with Power-Domain Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (PD-NOMA) for two user equipments. Developed imitation model in MATLAB/Simulink environment with Symbol Level - Successive Interference Cancellation (SL-SIC) is presented. Simulation parameters are equivalent of downlink 5G New Radio (5G NR) standard by 3GPP for second numerology with Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (QPSK) and Quadrature Amplitude Modulation (QAM) with order M = 16, 64, 256 on subcarriers. Presented dependencies BER from Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) for different levels mean power of signals on subcarriers for Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel. All presented results received for sample size providing confidence level no lower 90% and relative accuracy no more 10%.

articleTitle: Capacity and Spatial Efficiency of Multichannel Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Few-mode, multicore, and few-mode multicore optical fibers are considered. The concept of multichannel optical fibers (MChF) is introduced. The criterion of fiber channel order is formulated and the spatial-channel classification of optical fibers is being constructed. Analytical expressions for calculating the transfer and spatial parameters of MChF are presented. For variations in the spatial and spectral resource of quartz MChF, the values of capacity and spatial-rate efficiency are determined.

articleTitle: Electric Propulsion System Simulation as Basis for the Electric Vehicle Digital Twin Development
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Given the current automobile industry development state and its outlined trends we can confidently assert that the intrinsic part of implemented technologies both in near and far future will comprise of powertrain electrification in order to aid low-carbon development, complex intellectualization of vehicles and associated infrastructure. Thus, aspects mentioned above explain the objective topicality for creation of an electric vehicle virtual copy, digital twin, based on electric vehicle components and systems simulation. This being said, simulation models as such, apart from traditional use in theoretical studies at the development stage, become part of a strictly practical application - real vehicle operation. The present article suggests a traction inverter with integrated charger simulation model implementation as a part of a complex electric vehicle propulsion system simulation. Basic equation systems are applied in presented complex simulation that are fundamental for component simulation model and presented as structural schemes for further software implementation. The article additionally focuses on recreation of a fast charger as part of a suggested traction inverter. The depicted simulation model allows recreation of electric propulsion system processes in a scope of electric vehicle operation modes.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Core Network Structure of Geographically Distributed Communication System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the solution is proposed to the problem of synthesis of a core network for communication systems connecting information processing nodes in regional traffic control systems in air and ground transportation infrastructure distributed over a large territory, at considerable distances from each other. Results are obtained for calculation of core network parameters depending on its structure. The tasks of network structure synthesis are given. The results can be useful to developers and administrators of large network communication systems.

articleTitle: Integrated Control of Economic Security by Machine Learning in the Information Space of the Digital Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers a refined statement of the economic security control problem in the formation of a digital economy, developed on the basis of a probabilistic assessment of the implementation of organizational, technical and technological processes for ensuring economic security using a universal methodology. Methods and technologies for applying machine learning in control and ensuring of economic security, based on data from the information space of the digital economy, are given. A methodology and methods for assessing and predicting threats, assessing the vulnerability of economic systems and choosing the optimal strategy to counter them are proposed. Algorithms and the most suitable programming languages for the implementation of solutions to the problem are selected. It is possible only if there is an information space organized according to the paradigm of the digital economy.

articleTitle: Signal Recording System Control
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work is devoted to the modification of the recording device of the static sensing installation, for its operation under the control of an ultrasonic immersion sensor. The purpose of the main working units and order of their interaction are considered. The functions of the controller of the ultrasonic immersion sensor and the controller of the measuring board of the recording device are highlighted, the interaction of which should ensure the stable operation of the system. An algorithm for the calibration of an ultrasonic immersion sensor is considered. The process of registration of the signal transition time using the capture mode is described. The coefficients for calculating the distance between the sensors at a fixed time are experimentally determined. The mechanism of information exchange between controllers, which is based on the algorithm of continuous transmission of slowly changing values, is implemented. The analysis of data for the formation of control commands for the given external conditions has been worked out. Software methods for controlling false alarms are proposed. Functions of the remote control have been expanded. One of this is used for presetting the step between successive commands for registering results. In conclusion, the difficulties using an ultrasonic immersion sensor in the field are analyzed. All tests were carried out on the basis of a set of equipment for static sounding PIKA-19, manufactured by Scientific and Technical Center PIKA-TECHNOSERVICE LLC.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Efficiency of Blind Signal Separation in the Problem of Detecting BPSK Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper investigates the effectiveness of the blind signal separation algorithm in the problem of detecting digital BPSK signals. The classical methods of blind separation of signals and criteria for signal independence are considered. A model of the studied algorithm for blind signal separation is shown, based on the calculation of a mixing matrix that brings the joint cumulants of the second and fourth orders to zero. To exclude a trivial solution, additional restrictions are imposed on signal dispersions. A system of equations for finding the mixing matrix coefficients is presented. The form of the coefficients of the mixing matrix is shown, which brings the signals to an uncorrelated form. The possibility of an analytical solution of the equation associated with the equality of the joint fourth-order cumulant to zero is shown. A model of modulation and detection of digital signals is described. The simulation result of the blind signal separation algorithm is presented graphically. The efficiency of the proposed algorithm is shown.

articleTitle: Radar of Complex UAV Detection and Neutralization
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Potentially dangerous situations associated with unauthorized use of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV s) have been identified. The requirements for a radar designed for all-weather and round-the-clock detection of UAVs, including in conditions of intense reflections from buildings and underlying surface, were formulated. The structure and variants of the UAV detection and neutralization complex are presented, it includes a highly informative panoramic view radar as a primary detection sensor. The tasks and basic technical requirements for the mobile version of this complex are formulated. Examples of known radar solutions for UAVs detection are given. The main contradictions of requirements for the UAV detection radar are formulated. The solution of these contradictions, based on use of radar with ultrashort-pulse probing signals with radiofrequency filling, is given. The features and advantages of ultrashort-pulse radar (USPR) are considered. The characteristics of an USPR prototype for detecting UAVs and the results of demonstration tests, including in urban areas, are presented.

articleTitle: Two-Phase Digital Signal Modulation with Efficiency of 17 Bit Per Sample
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A system of two-phase signals with spread in space and summation into a radio channel according to the SIMO 2×1 scheme was designed. With correlated reception of the mixed (combined) signal, the system provides modulation efficiency of 17 bits/sample. The main problem (challenge) at receiving is resolving of ambiguity in determining the optimal value of the initial phase in the mixed (combined) signal, that defines the maximum modulus of the cross-correlation function of the signal. It is necessary to clarify the signs of the trigonometric functions of angles, which makes it possible to determine the true values of initial phases of the signals transmitted.

articleTitle: Research Indicators Nonlinear Effects in Fibre Optic Communication Lines in Use Wdm and Dwdm Technologies
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Efficiency indicators optical telecommunication systems using modern optical technologies spectral wavelength multiplexing have been analyzed. Influence nonlinear effects in fibre-optic transmission lines in dispersion control mode on the basis of which methods for calculation efficiency indicators of optical information transmission systems and algorithms for determination parameters single-mode optical fibres in dispersion control mode have been investigated. Analytical expressions are obtained, allowing to estimate efficiency of optical signal transmission systems based on technologies of spectral WDM (Wavelength Division Multiplexing) and dense spectral multiplexing DWDM (Dense WDM) channels by wavelength.

articleTitle: Modeling of Nonlinear Distortions in 5G NR Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Due to the peculiarities of the physical level of 5G NR (Fifth Generation New Radio) systems, nonlinear distortion of the amplifying path is one of the main negative affecting on the signal. Existing mathematical models of amplifier nonlinearities in the context of their application in the simulation of fifth-generation signals require adaptation. The work proposes the coefficients for nonlinear distortion of power amplifiers for Saleh and Ghorbani models. Based on the simulation model developed in MA TLAB, the spectral characteristics of the simulated processes of nonlinear distortion, amplitude-amplitude and amplitude-phase distortions, as well as the effect of nonlinearity on the noise immunity of the system (the dependence of the bit error rate (BER) from the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR)) for the 5G NR signal of the second numerology (200 MHz signal bandwidth) for all types of modulation supported by the standard on sub carrier frequencies (QPSK, 16QAM, 64QAM, 256QAM) are studied.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics of the BPSK-GLSS Demodulator
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The study results of dynamic characteristics of the quasi-coherent BPSK signal demodulator based on Globally Linearized Synchronization System (GLSS) are presented. GLSS is innovation phase lock loop structure (PLL) their optimized by speed in transient operation mode accordance with Pontryagin maximum principle. In demodulator structure using remodulation method for elimination of the information manipulation impact on the process of reference oscillation forming when BPSK signal receiving. By simulation methods provide study voltage epures in different structures point, and also phase trajectories of imaging point on system phase portraits, their illustrating dynamic characteristics in BPSK demodulation process.

articleTitle: Impact of Vehicles and Motorcycles on the Environment and "Smart City" as a way to Solve Transportation Problems of a Megapolis
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article examines the consequences of a large number of vehicles and their impact on the environment and creating a smart city to solve the transport problems of the megapolis. During the study, it was found out that at the moment the most dangerous impact from the car on the environment are: the consequences of an accident; emissions of harmful substances; thermal effects; noise; vibration; wear products; problems of recycling. One of the ways to solve the problem of environmental pollution can be the development of recuperation energy in road transport.

articleTitle: The Autonomous Object Trajectory Correction Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The issue of using neural networks to construct and correct the transport object trajectory is considered in this article. The control system, which includes the analysis of general unchangeable information received from global sensors, is considered. The decision on the need to change the trajectory is made depending on the data received from sensors located directly on the object. A method is proposed for correcting the autonomous object route depending on the occurrence of stationary obstacles during movement. A neural network is defined that minimizes the functional characterizing the cost of movement and its safety, taking into account the rebuilding.

articleTitle: Detection and Estimation of Parameters of a Random Process Set in Multi-Scanning Radar Observation Based on the "Track - Before- Detect" Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we consider methods of long-term (multi-scanning) radar observation based on "track-before-detect" technologies. We analyze a two-stage procedure for joint detection-estimation of trajectories. In the paper we prove the advisability of the use of a relatively simple a priori model of target movement at the traj ectory detection stage. We show that it is possible to use a more complex model at the stage of trajectory parameters estimation. The analysis of the well-known block algorithm for estimating trajectory parameters using the least squares method is carried out. We offer a methodology for testing the accuracy of traj ectory parameters measurements when implementing the block method of multi-scanning observation.

articleTitle: Fiber Optic Tire Speed Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents the results of modeling and comparative analysis of the real-time efficiency of the microwave photonic measurement system for assessing the angular velocity of a vehicle tire for two types of addressed fiber Bragg structures. The relevance of this research is due to the development of active vehicle safety and fiber-optic measuring devices. Since knowledge of the change in adhesion properties of the tire is the most important information for the active vehicle safety systems. This fact is forcing engineers to create measuring devices capable of measuring at a high sampling rate, which can be achieved using the technology of polling addressed fiber Bragg structures.

articleTitle: On Types of Traction Motors Used in the Leading Wheel Drive of Electric Passenger Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes types of traction e-motors used in the leading wheel drive of battery electric passenger vehicles produced by different international manufacturers at the present time. The article analyzes European and Asian models of electric buses and shows a significantly increased use of different types of synchronous electric vehicles with rare-earth permanent magnets. The article analyzes drive kinematic systems used at the present, such as the ones with a single centre motor and with motors for driving each leading wheel. The range for specific powers of vehicles, as well as the most probable average value of specific powers, are determined. Electric buses with multi-motor drives and high maximum driving speeds (more than 70 km/h) have large values of specific powers. The article contains values of specific powers for traction electric motors at the rate from 0.75 to 3 kW /kg. The article describes motor operating conditions and determines the most probable operating modes. It concludes about the most optimal use of synchronous motors in the drive energized by high-quality rare-earth permanent magnets in terms of their maximum efficiency, overall dimensions and specific energy characteristics under these conditions.

articleTitle: Fractional Power Spectra in Diagnostics of controlled Anishchenko-Astakhov System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the consideration of the diagnostics of the controlled discrete-nonlinear Anishchenko-Astakhov system by the fractional-power spectra of the signals generated by the system. The conditions for the closeness of the system of fractional power-law functions of time, which reduce the errors in the representation of signals of discrete-nonlinear systems by fractional power series, are determined. The peculiarities of the representation of the signals of the discrete-nonlinear Anishchenko-Astakhov system by pulse sequences with expansion in fractional powers of time are revealed, its adequacy in the analysis of system signals is confirmed. Two-dimensional and three-dimensional fractional-power spectra of the signals of the discrete-nonlinear Anishchenko-Astakhov system have been constructed. The ranges of variation of indicators of fractional powers and normalized pulse durations have been determined. The dependence of the structure of fractional power-law spectra of signals of a controlled discrete-nonlinear Anishchenko-Astakhov system, modified by modulation of time sampling parameters, on the modulation depth of control actions, which reduce the correlation intervals of the generated pseudo-random signals, is revealed.

articleTitle: Study of the Effect of the Equatorial Ionosphere Anomaly on the Polarizing Characteristics of HF Radio Waves
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A study of the change in the polarization characteristics of high-frequency radio waves, caused by the influence of the Earth's ionosphere in the region of the equatorial anomaly, is carried out on the basis of the Hamilton-Lukin bicharacteristic method. The dependence of the group time of signal arrival on the coordinate of the ray exit is considered. The rate of phase change along the rays from height, phase deviation as a function of group time and horizontal coordinates, as well as differences of refraction indicators of ordinary and unusual wave as the function of height along the rays are investigated. The angle of Faraday rotation in the meridian direction at the receiving point is calculated taking into account the change in the magnitude and orientation of the magnetic field and the influence of the equatorial anomaly of the ionosphere and its surroundings. The calculations are made for three frequencies: 336 MHz, 436 MHz and 536 MHz.

articleTitle: Researches Methods for Increasing the Throughput of Fiber-Optical Communication Networks Based on Optical Spectral Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An analysis of the advantages using the architectural concept of the following NGN (Next Generation Network) and future FN (Future Network) networks to build optical multi-service telecommunication systems based on the technology spectral separation information channels, supporting a wide range multimedia services, was carried out. Efficiency, communication quality and transfer characteristics fiber-optic communication networks using optical means as receiving optical modules (ROM), fiber-optic cables (FOC) and transmitting optical modules (TOM) were investigated. Based on the study, a new approach has been proposed to create methods for calculating the throughput indicators fiber-optic communication networks based on spectral separation technology, which are based on the principles wavelength multiplexing. Based on calculation methods, analytical expressions are obtained to estimate line performance, optical signal-to-noise ratio at the output communication lines and transfer characteristics fibre-optic communication lines using single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: Modeling Methods Comparison of Urban Public Transport Movement for ITS
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Urban public transport development is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and improve social mobility efficiency in cities. Improving bus transportation quality is helping to attract more passengers by eliminating private cars. This can only happen if total effect of urban public transport use exceeds all advantages of using individual transport mobility. In most cases, when buses arrival time at stopping points is not predicted, and buses themselves move out of schedule, there can be no question of any worthy alternative to personal transport. This is one of obvious factors in decline in passenger transport services quality. This article presents three methods for modeling traffic flow for predicting buses arrival times at stopping points: based on Markov chains, based on an improved hydrodynamic model and based on the use operational calculus elements and reducing solution of equations posed to integral equations numerical solutions taking into account spatiotemporal characteristics of buses movement. These methods have been tested in practice within modeling traffic flows framework in the Vologda (Russia) city to assess possibility and features of predicting buses arrival time at stopping points. On the basis of practical application, recommendations are given on possibility of using these methods in ITS implementation for large cities.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Modulated Frequency-Selective Surfaces on Mushroom-Shaped Metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents the results of computer simulation of modulated metasurfaces with mushroom-shaped unit cells. The metasurfaces were designed as a wide wall of a waveguide and as a part of microstrip transmission line. The combination of two types of unit cells that are identical in shape but different in size provides a synergy that allows creating frequency-selective devices with several stop-bands. The proposed devices were simulated using CST Studio Suite and Ansoft HFSS.

articleTitle: Data Hiding and Transmission Over Occupied Audio Channels Using Deterministic Chaos
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The efficiency of the algorithm for hiding and transmitting digital information simultaneously with audio signals is analyzed by the method of spreading the spectrum using chaotic signals. The efficiency of the proposed algorithm is estimated by the amount of distortion introduced into the cover audio, as well as by the reliability of extracting the embedded information, which is characterized by the value of the error probability. It is shown that in order to extract pseudorandom sequence with high reliability from cover audio, preference should be given to the mother Daubechies and Simlet wavelets. Requirements for the numerical values of the embedding parameters and the parameters of the generators of chaotic processes used to expand the spectrum are formulated. It was found that to ensure the required reliability of extracting the built-in pseudorandom sequence, it is necessary to ensure the discrepancy between the parameters of the chaos generators on the transmitting and receiving sides of less than 0.15.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cellular Vehicle-to-Everything Physical Layer Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Intelligent transportation systems is one of the most popular research topics nowadays. Current IEEE standard is named IEEE 802.11 p. Its further enhancement 802.11 bd are now developed and addressed to eliminating of main 802.11 p drawbacks which are the poor scalability and performance in high mobility scenarios. The third V2X standard is 3GPP-NR-V2X which physical layer parameters is presented within this work. The link-level evaluation of the upcoming vehicular to everything standard NR-V2X is presented in the paper. The throughput measurement has been chosen as the quality parameter. The results compare with the Dedicated Short Range Communication and show that NR V2X outperform DSRC in throughput characteristic.

articleTitle: Integrated starter-generator using switched reluctance electric motor for N1 category vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Demands to reduce exhaust gas emissions are increasing in proportion to the growth trends in the number of vehicles on the planet. Hybrid and electric vehicles solve the problem, but they are quite expensive and require additional charging infrastructure, the rapid development of which is impossible in some countries. Reducing emissions can be achieved through the use of additional electrical devices and an integrated 48V starter generator (ISG) with start-stop, boost and recuperation functions. The article discusses the practical experience of research on ISG based on a switched reluctance electrical machine (SRM). The results of research on N1vehicles with ISG. Test results of reducing fuel consumption and exhaust fumes emission are presented. The efficiency value of motor and generator operating modes of SRM is showed. The hybrid energy source with ultracapacitors showed reliable starting of the internal combustion engine at a temperature of −35 C. The issues of changing vibration characteristics, control strategy and improvement of control algorithms are considered. Results of efficiency increase in the range of rotation frequencies up to 2500 rpm are presented

articleTitle: LTE Cell Load Estimation Based on DCI Message Decoding
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: For modern mobile communication systems, the task of analyzing the parameters of quality of service and network information load remains one of the most popular. There are several ways getting this information in LTE networks. For example, by evaluation of test signals or estimation special reference signals in LTE frame. In this paper, it is proposed to obtain information about the cell load by decoding service messages of the DCI control information block. The main idea of this method is that the information load of LTE cell is estimated by decoding DCI messages in the LTE physical control channel and establishing the number of unique identifiers. For decoding the LTE signal, was used MATLAB LTE Toolbox and software-defined radio platform USRP 2920. In the work, the UE detection algorithm was tested on the signal generated using MATLAB software, and evaluated the information load of the network of a real LTE base station.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Approach to Freight Transportation Using Pooling Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the problems of delivery of small consignments from manufacturers. The problems of flexibility of a modern logistics system, which must be constantly adjusted for high-quality and efficient satisfaction of consumer demand, are considered. The article discusses the impact of delivery by half-empty vehicles on the cost of the final product.
