The authors consider the possibility of increasing the efficiency of the transport process by means of using terminal warehouse complexes and determine their place and role in the technological scheme of the transport cycle for the delivery of goods by road. The article discusses the use of pooling technology in transportation, as well as the prospects of this system in Russia. The authors consider the possibility of using a multi-agent approach to solving problems that arise when using pooling technology. The efficiency of the pooling technology will be achieved through the creation of intelligent agents that can quickly plan and reschedule the allocation of resources in accordance with dynamically changing conditions. They also single out autonomous agents in the future system and establish connections between their interactions. Agents can interact with each other, exchanging messages, analyze received messages, make decisions in conditions of uncertainty and lack of information. One of the features of an agent is its ability to learn, based on the use of knowledge bases in a certain field of activity, containing decision-making models, optimization, analysis algorithms, learning.

articleTitle: Recognition of Human Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the importance of recognizing human behavior in the modern world. Several main companies are considered and compared with each other on products from different manufacturers engaged in the development of software for human behavior recognition. Article proposes methodology for recognizing human emotions on photo and video. Methodology is based on YOLOv4. Proposed algorithm recognizes seven types of human emotions. Our methodology can be used in different industry companies to analyze employees' actions at workplace.

articleTitle: High Efficientcy 1.5 kW LDMOS HF Broadband Radio Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The design of HF radio transmitters with a power more than 300W requires the use of summing devices that combine the powers of individual amplifiers. The use of combiners leads to the complication of the transmitter and increase its dimensions and weight, which is very critical for onboard equipment. Attempts to develop a broadband amplifier with a power 1500 … 1800 W on a modern LDMOS transistor revealed certain difficulties associated with the parasitic parameters of a powerful amplifier. To achieve high output power of a transistor amplifier, it is necessary to reduce the load resistance of the output circuit of the final stage. In this case, the negative influence of the parasitic parameters of the output oscillatory circuit increases. The dissipation inductance of the transformer-short circuit and the mounting inductance in a class AB linear amplifier cause an increased voltage level of the even harmonics of the oscillatory voltage at the transistor drains, which reduces the attainable power of the amplifier while maintaining its safe mode of operation. The energy stored in parasitic inductances in switching amplifiers can lead to the destruction of transistors by self-induction voltage. In this article, we propose a mode of operation of transistors in a switching mode, which ensures high energy efficiency and full use of transistors in terms of power. The proposed mode can be successfully applied as part of an amplifier implemented using the Envelope Elimination and Restoration method (EER, also known as the Kahn technique). This method are most preferred for use in onboard devices where the supply power is limited.

articleTitle: Constellations of Discrete Modulation Laws that have the Maximum Information Capacity Per Symbol Under Peak Power Limitation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Calculation was made of optimal structures for constellations of discrete modulation where the maximum information quantity is provided per one symbol. Results were achieved for regular practical application conditions with limitation on the peak power of the transmitted signal. It is established that multi-ring constellations with a different number of points on each of the rings are optimal. It is shown that with an increase in the signal-to-noise ratio, the optimal multi-ring structure of constellation undergoes changes consisting in a gradual increase in the radii of the inner rings, the appearance of new positions in the vicinity of the center of the constellation and an increase in the total number of constellation points. Rings located farther from the center of the constellation always have a larger number of points than rings located closer to the center. It is found that the typical QPSK modulation, starting with a signal-to-noise ratio of 5 dB, loses to the optimal constellations in terms of the information capacity of a single symbol by a value of 0.67 dB or more in the representation of effective losses for the useful signal level. Is found that the information capacity of the optimal multi-ring constellation practically does not depend on the initial phases of the uniform points positions distributions on rings. It is also established that for each signal-to-noise ratio there is a minimum value of points of the optimal constellation starting from which the information capacity not increase.

articleTitle: Some Questions of Histogram Approximation for the Lengthened Objects Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The core idea of this paper is detection of lengthened objects by the radar signal. The methodological base of the exploration is statistical processing of the reflected signal. The lengthened objects are those objects of underlying surface, which could be presented by straight line. It is assumed that the radar is mounted on the unmanned airborne vehicle and this detection system is oriented to help navigation system to detect vehicle's position. This idea was presented in previous papers, but this exact paper is concentrated on the practical aspect of algorithm application, i.e. problems of histograms approximation parameters for the reflected signal, method of histogram approximation and etc. The estimation of the corresponding parameters allows us to increase the accuracy of the designed algorithm.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Antenna System Based on a Metastructure with the Property of an Artificial Magnetic Conductor
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The principle of construction and functioning of a combined VHF/UHF antenna system with a frequency ratio of 1:3 is implemented, using a metastructure with the property of an artificial magnetic conductor (artificial magnetic conductor - AMC), which allows to reduce the height of the antenna system's profile and reduce the mutual influence of the bands. An experimental study of the layout of a combined dual-band low-profile antenna system in a single aperture using the principle of electrodynamic similarity was carried out. Dimension in the VHF band (1x2) with printed vibratory emitters, dimension in the UHF band (4x2) based on two-dimensional printed emitters. The measured characteristics (S-parameters, radiation patterns, gain) confirmed the validity of the proposed technical solution of a low-profile antenna system with the preservation of the main ratio technical characteristics. The profile of the combined VHF and UHF antenna system is 62% less compared to the classical case of combined vibratory-vibratory antenna systems.

articleTitle: Investigation of the QPSK-GLSS Demodulator using Phase Space Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The analysis of the structure of the quasi-coherent demodulator QPSK-GLSS, based on the globally linearized synchronization system (GLSS), is carried out. GLSS is an innovative structure of the phase-lock loop (PLL) system, optimized for speed in the transient mode of operation in accordance with the Pontryagin maximum principle. The paper investigates the dynamic characteristics of the structure of the QPSK-GLSS demodulator using the phase space method. Shown are the voltage diagrams and phase trajectories of the imaging point on the phase portraits of the system in the process of demodulating the QPSK signal. For the research, the methods of simulation were used in the work. The results obtained illustrate the high dynamics and structural efficiency of the remodulation construction method used in the development of the QPSK-GLSS quasi-coherent demodulator.

Author Keywords: highspeed globally linearized synchronization system GLSS
analysis based on the three-dimensional phase space

articleTitle: Using Neural Networks to Navigate Robots Among Obstacles
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the paper a new method of positioning the robot in space is proposed, characterized by the application of an artificial neural network to ultrasonic sensors. The method is based on the use of a smooth neural network. The network structure is proposed and a set of input parameters is defined, which are obtained from the developed experimental installation. The neural network has been trained with the aid of an algorithm to reverse spread the error on the collected set of learning examples. Comparison of the proposed method with existing technologies that are used to solve the navigation problem. The new method allowed for the construction of maps of the depth of the surrounding space (3D vision) and could be implemented for the navigation of robots among obstacles.

articleTitle: Digital Processing of Radar Signals in the Automatic Helicopter Landing System on a Moving Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of landing a helicopter on a moving platform in difficult weather conditions. The article presents a study of the possibility of automatic determination of coordinates, using antennas located on the blades of a helicopter propeller, relative to the landing site where the radio signal sources are located. This arrangement of the antennas when moving in space allows you to measure the distance to the source of the radio signal due to the Doppler shift of the signal frequency. The implementation of such a system can make it possible to solve the most complex aviation tasks to ensure navigation during takeoff/landing in difficult weather conditions, as well as during search and rescue operations. Such a technical solution allows you to get the direction of the radiation source of the radio signal, as well as the range to it with high accuracy.

Author Keywords: determining the coordinates of the radio signal source
the antenna on the helicopter rotor blades

articleTitle: Methodology for Evaluating the Probability of Communication Disconnection in Radio Channels of the Systems with Space-Time Coding of Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a methodology for assessing the probability of communication disruptions in one beam of a radio communication system operating on the technology of space-time coding of signals. Expressions are given for an accurate and for an approximate estimate of the probability of communication disruptions in radio channels with multipath and signal fading. Long-term experimental studies of signal fading on a long-range tropospheric radio link have been carried out. It has been experimentally proven that the Rayleigh description of interference fading in multipath propagation of signals is observed in 60% of the time of communication sessions. For the rest of the communication sessions, other laws of probability distribution are observed. It is confirmed that they, together with Rayleigh's description of fading, are special cases of the four-parameter law of probability distribution. Convenient for practical use formulas are obtained for estimating the noise immunity of a communication channel. The graphs of the dependence of the probability of communication failure on the ratio of the average received signal power and the threshold level of the receiver signal are given.

articleTitle: Tribo-Characteristics of Promising Cutting Fluids for Metal Cutting
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper presents a new formulation based on mineral oil and a non-ionic surfactant as a lubricant-cooling liquid (coolant). The results of studies of tribo-characteristics of various coolant formulations, as well as the influence of the process medium on the anticorrosive resistance of the treated surface are presented. Recommendations on the choice of highperformance coolant for metal cutting are given.

articleTitle: Brain Map Data Based Aggressive Driving Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Zero-collision program in traffic has become an important target for many metropolises and regions. Among the wide range of traffic accidents reasons the human factor plays one of the most significant roles. Monitoring, analysis and control of driver's behavior is the way to drastically improve the traffic safety. The driver's biological responses and parameters control combined with the modern driving assistance technologies provides a great opportunity to decrease human error. This paper proposes a system, which is based on EEG (electroencephalogram) recording and predicts emotion fluctuations which can cause the dramatic decision making.

articleTitle: Optimisation of the Rotor Speed as a way to Improve Specific Indicators of Traction Electric Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The issue of ensuring performance with a minimum mass of electrical machines is a task for designing traction electric motors. This article discusses ways to increase the flux linkage and one of the most effective ways is to increase the flux linkage by increasing the rotational speed, since, unlike other methods, this method does not increase the phase resistance and, accordingly, the energy loss in the winding. The main energy losses in an electric machine and the influence of the rotor speed on energy losses are also analysed. Therefore, knowing the losses in the electric machine, the efficiency of the electric machine was calculated. As a result of the study, it was revealed that an increase in the rotational speed leads to a decrease in mass and dimensions, but to a decrease in the efficiency of an electric machine. The optimal values of the rotational speed must be determined for each electric machine, thereby ensuring high efficiency, minimum weight and dimensions, as well as providing the necessary traction and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Development of the Research Stand for Exploration of Models and Algorithms for Group Control of Ground-Based Mobile Robots
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the process of developing a research stand for exploration of models and algorithms for group control of ground-based mobile robots at the Department of Intelligent Systems in Control and Automation. The role of robotics in science, technology and education is considered. The tasks most effectively solved by means of group robotics are defined. The classification of centralized and decentralized group control strategies is given. A formal statement of the problem of group control of robots is given. The structure of the robot control system for distributed collective and pack control strategies is presented. The task is to develop a research stand for exploration of models and algorithms for controlling a group of mobile robots. The prospects of using the research stand in the research work of the department are described. The functional and electrical diagram of the ground-based mobile robot is given.

articleTitle: Navigational Information as the Basis for Constructing an Econometric Model for Evaluating the Factors of Transport Operation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of official statistical data on the number of passengers carried on various modes of transport, in order to identify the factors that affect the differences in the dynamics of passenger traffic. The distribution of passenger flows across the subjects of the Russian Federation is carried out, focused on determining the degree of influence of regional development on passenger transportation by road. The method of collecting the actual indicators of passenger movement on road transport is considered. As sources of primary information, it is proposed to use the equipment of on-board navigation and communication equipment with a GLONASS/GPS module with an antenna. The processing of navigation data and the formation of information about the transport process along the route at each stop allows you to simulate the process. It becomes possible to analyze traffic in detail on the map of the route network in the context of belonging to certain transport systems. Given the fact that in practice it is difficult to collect information about all the factors in the field of passenger transportation, and it is often impossible to obtain them in full, as well as these factors do not have a functional relationship, it is proposed to evaluate the statistical performance of passenger transport through the use of econometric models that are amenable to the necessary adjustments and take into account non-functional relationships of influencing factors.

Author Keywords: automated navigation systems for dispatch control

articleTitle: Research of the Influence of Nonlinearity of Capacitance-Voltage Characteristics of Field-Effect Transistors on Nonlinear Distortions in Distributed Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The model of distributed power amplifier, built on field-effect transistors of model MRF 9045, is presented. AM -AM characteristic and AM - PM characteristic investigated on the basis of this amplifier circuit are presented. The construction of a distributed power amplifier circuit for simplified modeling of parametric nonlinear distortion is discussed. Simplified models of this type of amplifiers for the HF and UHF ranges are given. In a simplified model for the HF range, the parametric capacitances are built on the basis of the capacitance-voltage characteristics on the field-effect transistor of model BLF 278. In the simplified model for the UHF range, the parametric capacitances are built on the basis of the capacitance-voltage characteristics on the field-effect transistor of model MRF 9045. The features of constructing a simplified model of a distributed gain amplifier are discussed. On the basis of simplified models of parametric nonlinear distortion amplifiers, several cases of the influence of parametric capacitances are investigated such as: the influence of the input parametric capacitance, as well as the influence of the output parametric capacitance. The result of the research is the amplitude and phase-amplitude characteristics. The reasons for parametric nonlinear distortions and methods of their linearization are discussed. Further research tasks are presented.

articleTitle: Modeling of a Road Traffic Accident Using Multivariate Analysis of Injuries in a Two-Wheeled Vehicle Collision with a Car
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The purpose of this study is to study the kinematics of the road accidents movement and the factors influencing the degree of injury from collisions of a two-wheeled vehicle with a car by modeling a road traffic accident. The analysis of the effect of vehicle speed on the degree of injury for a certain moment of collision has been carried out. A quantitative assessment is given to the factors influencing the degree of injury from road accidents. Depending on the vehicle speed, collision time, graphs were built and regression equations were obtained.

articleTitle: The Repeater with Global Positioning System for Cellular Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In cellular communication systems, the distance from base station to subscriber equipment is limited. In cases where this distance cannot be reduced, it is suggested to introduce a repeater using a location detection method, such as GPS, to increase the range. The distance between the nearest base station and the repeater maybe calculated by determining the coordinates of the repeater and the base station. By increasing the power of both the repeater and the base station transmitters, and changing the time advance, the repeater may be connected to the base station. The connection between the subscriber terminal and the base station is facilitated through the repeater

Author Keywords: calculation of distance between mobile and base stations

articleTitle: The Cyber Attack on the Corporate Network Models Theoretical Aspects
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Mathematical model of web server protection is being proposed based on filtering HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) packets that do not match the semantic parameters of the request standards of this protocol. The model is defined as a graph, and the relationship between the parameters - the sets of vulnerabilities of the corporate network, the methods of attacks and their consequences-is described by the Cartesian product, which provides the correct interpretation of a corporate network cyber attack. To represent the individual stages of simulated attacks, it is possible to separate graph models in order to model more complex attacks based on the existing simplest ones. The unity of the model proposed representation of cyber attack in three variants is shown, namely: graphic, text and formula.

articleTitle: Geographic Information Systems to Improve Road Safety
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article proposes solution for analyzing road safety level on sections of road network (RN) using geographic information systems as part of intelligent transport systems (ITS). Namely, one of DCRE (Driver-Car-Road-Environment) system components - “road”, and its impact on traffic safety, were studied in detail, and solutions for identifying typical sections in geoinformation systems (GIS) were presented. Various factors affecting road safety, accident likelihood and severity of their consequences are considered, depending on hazardous areas location (in settlements and beyond).

articleTitle: Simulation of the Heat Current Limitation Algorithm for the Traction Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The most relevant issue in the field of research of battery vehicles with traction electric drive is the question of the operation of the traction battery (TB). The article discusses the characteristic features of the operation of lithium-ion batteries. The influence of changes in the operating parameters of the TB on the battery calendar life and the occurrence of negative effects is estimated. The algorithm of current limitation in the battery control system is considered. The article describes the principle of operation of the heat current limitation algorithm on the example of a mathematical model.

articleTitle: Applying Blind Signal Processing Methods in Data-Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The problem of increasing the noise-proof feature of communication systems, along with increasing the communication channel capacity, is currently important. In many areas of wireless engineering (in radiolocation and communications for example), it becomes necessary to receive and process signals, some characteristics of which (for example, amplitude, frequency, or initial phase) are unknown. Methods of statistical radio engineering, as well as algorithms for blind signal processing, can be used to eliminate a priori uncertainty. The problem of comparative analysis of some common algorithms for blind signal processing in the tasks of separating radio signals from mixtures with interference and noise was considered. In the study, the algorithms JADE, FastICA, SOBI and AMUSE were considered. Amplitude-, frequency- and phase-shift keyed signals against the background of additive noise, impulse noise and cochannel noise were considered as useful signals. Based on the results of simulation modeling, the effectiveness of these algorithms is compared when distinguishing between several types of signals in the presence of various types of interference. The above research results can be useful when choosing a blind processing algorithm for subsequent practical application.

Author Keywords: increasing the noise-proof feature of communication systems

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Routing in Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The report deals with the problem of developing and analyzing the characteristics of routing algorithms that ensure economical use of on-Board electricity of network nodes (energy-efficient routes). The urgency of the problem is caused by the need to increase the time of Autonomous functioning of the sensor network. Reducing power consumption is achieved by creating routes with small distances between adjacent nodes. This problem is solved if the network nodes are located and operate within a flat bounded area. For each route section, the required transmission power is determined based on the minimum energy potential value that ensures the specified data transmission quality. The analysis of the metric properties of routes is carried out, the requirements for energy-efficient routes and the conditions under which the network is fully connected are determined. Limitations of local routing methods are determined and options for improving the efficiency of energy-efficient routing algorithms are proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensory Strain Measurement Using Addressed Fiber Bragg Structures in Load Sensing Bearings
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The work presents modeling results of the fiber-optic multi-sensory strain measurement system for load sensing wheel hub bearings based on the addressed fiber Bragg structures (AFBS) with two symmetrical phase shifts. The system includes six strain sensors attached to the outer ring of the bearing and one senor isolated from strain for temperature compensation. The results of the numerical modeling are presented, as well as the simulation results of a complete optoelectronic interrogation scheme, which confirm the high accuracy of the AFBS central wavelengths determination by means of the microwave-photonic interrogation approach. The proposed load-sensing bearings can be used to estimate of the loads acting on the wheels of the vehicle, which serve as input parameters for active safety systems or fully automated driving, in order to enhance their effectiveness and safety of the vehicle.

articleTitle: Methodology of Microscopic Traffic Prediction for Automated Driving
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: We present a methodology for short-time (several seconds) microscopic prediction of traffic situation round of an automated driving vehicle moving in mixed traffic flow. The methodology for short-time microscopic prediction of traffic situation can be used by the automated driving vehicle for the planning of vehicle trajectory with the objective of speed harmonization in mixed traffic flow, collision avoidance, increase traffic safety and comfort.

articleTitle: Influence of Tribotechnical Composition on Engine Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The tribotechnical coating helps to reduce the coefficient of friction and improve the fuel efficiency of the combustion engine. There are many different oil additives on the market, and in most cases the manufacturer gives little data on the consequences of their use in the engine, the specific results of such use, and does not disclose information on the mechanisms of action of these compositions. A separate issue is the study of the effect of these additives on the properties of engine oil and the mechanisms of its aging. The paper presents the results of using the tribological composition ArmActiv Moto 4 © in a single-cylinder diesel engine. The test program provided for the introduction of the additive according to the manufacturer's instructions and its subsequent change after the processing interval to obtain the results of the effect of the additive on the surface of engine parts. The results of measuring the power, torque and fuel consumption of both the base engine and the engine treated with the tribotechnical composition are presented. The research results showed that as a result of the influence of the additive, a certain decrease in fuel consumption and an increase in power indicators were obtained, most pronounced in the area of average revolutions.

articleTitle: Features of the Data Modeling Method of the Composite Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Methods for modeling input data for the filter of statistical processing of target motion parameters are considered. The inputs are measurements some coordinates of the phase vector and variance or standard deviations of these measurements. When debugging the filter in laboratory conditions, these the inputs are commonly referred to as the measurement model and the error model of those measurements. It is very important that these models are as close as possible to real measurements and their standard deviations. The closer the model is to real data, the more accurate the filter will work, although of course, no model can match the actual data perfectly. For this reason, always after testing on model data, the transition to real data entails some deterioration in the filter's performance. To this circumstance it is necessary to be ready and perhaps it makes sense in laboratory tests to lay the features of real work, when situations are possible when measurements do not come at all, and the standard deviations take on abnormally high values. In this article discusses measurement models in an additive form - an exact value plus a normally distributed random variable with zero mathematical expectation and some standard deviations. These random variables are independent as the coordinates of one vector and independent with respect to the coordinates of another vector one random process. Such a model of errors is due to the presence of many factors independently introducing an error (interference) and their summation. The article discusses the methodology for obtaining the root-mean-square measurement by the true coordinates and obtaining a measurement model based on these standard deviations. The standard deviation model for each the radar station can have its own, and therefore it is important to know which station will track the target. When designing an escort filter, it is important also test it with different standard deviation models. The modeling features of the input data are therefore very important in the development of statistical processing filters.

Author Keywords: systems of autonomous ordinary differential equations

articleTitle: High Voltage Fiber Optic Sensor Modeling and Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents the calculation and computer simulation of piezoelectric transducers made of quartz single crystal and TsTS-19. Piezoelectric transformers are part of fiber optic voltage transformers, which are an alternative replacement for the currently used electromagnetic voltage transformers. The use of fiber optic technologies allows you to get rid of the problems inherent in electromagnetic transformers, such as large mass and, as a result, the need for large installation costs, expensive insulation for very high voltages, saturation effect, high cost due to the use of a large amount of non-ferrous metals. Also, when using optical sensors, it becomes easier to combine them into one fiber-optic measuring system, the "sensor-active equipment" distance significantly increases, which leads us to use such systems in the Smart Grid + direction. This technology allows the use of fully optical metrological equipment and equipment for transmitting information to an information processing server at transformer substations.

articleTitle: Methods for Ensuring Full Traceability of the Production Testing Results of the Digital VLSI
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article proposes a new approach to the localization of defects in digital very large integrated circuits (VLSI), which are currently widely used in digital signal processing systems. This approach made it possible to significantly reduce the labor intensity and development time of VLSI. The fact is that the technological preparation of their production includes over 800 operations with control of up to hundreds of parameters on each of them. Due to the large dimension of the problem, at present in production, complete control (traceability) of the results of testing digital VLSI is replaced by partial, which generally removes the question of its effectiveness due to human intervention in this process. In the article, for the first time, full traceability of the results of production control operations in automatic mode is realized, thanks to the constantly maintained two-way communications between adjacent operations of technological preparation of VLSI production.

articleTitle: Modeling and Researching a Sliding Correlator
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When complex spread spectrum signals are received, their processing is performed by a correlator or matched filter. Thanks to available modern integrated processors and low-noise ADCs, the correlation of the received signal with its copy occurs in digital form. That is, the signal is converted into digital form, after which the calculation of the correlation function is performed using an FPGA or a processor. At the same time, there are simpler ways to find the correlation peak. Modeling one of these methods - using a sliding correlator - is discussed in this article.

articleTitle: Influence of Auxiliary Braking Systems on Deceleration of Vehicles of Category M1
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The auxiliary braking systems of vehicles of category M1, installed from the factory and affecting deceleration, are considered. Comparison of the results of steady-state deceleration on dry asphalt concrete pavement at an air temperature of +17 ± 0,5°C will be carried out. For further experimental studies, factors and systems will be identified. Studies have shown that auxiliary systems affect the stability of deceleration and its magnitude. Comparison of vehicle deceleration with different blocks of auxiliary systems is made. The influence of developing auxiliary systems allows for a shorter braking distance, improved braking stability and an increased deceleration value. Keywords-brake system, ABS, braking, car component, smart system.

articleTitle: Simulation of Fast Transformation Procedures in Galois Fields to Estimate Efficiency of Perspective Signals Generation and Processing Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The object of consideration is design automation and prototyping of complex signals and their generation and processing devices. The subject of the analysis is the substantiation of the structure, composition and implementation method of a modeling system aimed at modeling and prototyping promising devices for the generation and processing of complex signals based on fast transformations in Galois fields. The purpose of the analysis is a reasonable choice of methods and tools for computational, simulation and prototyping that achieve high display accuracy, performance, flexibility and ease of modeling. The solutions are based on the principles and mathematical models developed by the authors: methods and algorithms for fast transformations in Galois fields, an algebraic representation model and the structure of fast delay acquisition devices for a subclass of sequences. The article is devoted to the development of a software and hardware modeling systems that allows the most accurate mapping of fast algebraic transformations in Galois fields to algorithmic models of various levels of representation to ensure high performance, flexibility and ease of modeling, as well as prototyping of promising devices for the generation and processing of complex signals. The results of the work will be useful in the design of promising devices of various information and communication systems, scientific research, as well as in the educational process.

articleTitle: Interference Compensator for Communication Systems with Space-Time Coding
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The known methods of signal processing of information transmission systems with space-time coding are quite successful in combating signal fading. However, these methods do not reduce the influence of external interference signals correlated in different reception channels. The article proposes a method for compensating external interference to systems with space diversity. The structure of the interference compensator is described. The method has been experimentally investigated. The experiments used a communication system with 2x space diversity. The proposed interference compensator showed the ability to suppress external narrow-band radio interference by at least 40 dB, and broadband barriers by 15 dB.

articleTitle: Methodology for Creating a Reference Reflection Spectra Database for Space Objects Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The analysis of the influence of identical materials simultaneously stored in a special database on the accuracy of quantitative interpretation of reflection spectra in the framework of monitoring space objects is carried out. It is proposed to use a new classification of the reflection spectra of materials and coatings (according to the cross-correlation coefficient) and leave one material in each class of the generated database. The dependence of the identification performance on the threshold value of the correlation coefficient is shown.

articleTitle: Comparison of Energy Metrics and Levels of Passive Interference for UWB Radars With Radio and Video Pulse Probing Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Signals properties comparative analysis is carried out for ultra-wideband pulse radar probing signals, which have equal spatial resolution and duration, but differ by presence or absence of high frequency filling. The broadband factor is used, defined as the relation of the probing signal bandwidth to its spectrum average frequency. Signal-to-noise and signal-to-passive interference ratios dependences on the broadband coefficient are obtained. It is shown that for the same antenna system aperture, dimensions and radiation power, the signal-to-noise ratio in a radar with a radio-pulse probing signal will be higher. That benefit is inversely proportional to the broadband factor square. Assuming that the passive interference level is proportional to the selection element area, its estimation is obtained. It is shown that when the spectral bands of ultrashort video and radio pulse probing signals are equal, the pulse with high-frequency filling has an advantage, in terms of the considered parameters.

articleTitle: Modeling the Narrowband and Wideband Noise at the Output of Nonlinear Converters
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the features of narrow-band processes at the output of the amplitude detector. Much attention is paid to the appearance of phase jumps by π when the signal envelope passes through zero and their disappearance, since the use of this feature allows us to propose a number of methods to increase the noise immunity of receiving devices. The article also uses a mathematical model built in the MATLAB environment to determine the ratio of the signal spectrum to the average frequency, at which the transition of the narrowband process to the wideband process occurs.

articleTitle: Development of a Phase Space Model of the Transportation Process in Urban Transportation Systems, and its Use to Assess the Quality of the Process of Transporting Passengers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the estimation of passenger's transportation process amount and level of service. The relevance of this topic is determined by the fact that urban passenger transport plays an important role for the population of cities in Russia and in the world. The administrations of large cities and mega polices consider this type of transport as the main tool for improving the difficult transport situation daily appearing in the sections of the road network. These problems can be solved successfully if the population begins to use urban passenger transport more and use personal vehicles less. To achieve this goal, it is necessary to significantly improve the quality of service provided by urban passenger transport, based on the use of automated control systems for urban passenger transport, which, first, should ensure the regularity of the movement of public transport vehicles and, secondly, provide comfortable conditions for passenger transportation. A particular influence on the quality of passenger service in urban passenger transport is the reliability of the transportation process, which is directly related to the regularity of traffic, and the comfort of transportation, which is estimated by the degree of vehicle interior occupation. The passenger transport management system should receive information about the degree of passenger vehicle interior occupation in order to be able to regulate the transportation process on-line and not allow the passenger compartment to be overflowed. For this purpose, a special phase space model of the transportation process states is suggested. Two dimensions coordinate system enables to represent transportation process at any time for any route of public transport. Moreover, the phase space is divided into subspaces each of them corresponds to a certain level of service. The developed methodology allows you to estimate the amount of transport work, taking into account the level of service provided on each part of the urban transport route.

articleTitle: Assessment of Traffic Management Measures Impact on the Population Health Living Near the Highway
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: As a criterion of intelligent transport systems (ITS) effectiveness, it is proposed to use the assessment of a road traffic management (RTM) measures impact on the population health living near the highway. ITS are designed, among other things, for regulating traffic in automatic mode. To build mathematical models of this regulation impact on the automobile traffic output indicators, various subroutines are needed to determine the desired dependencies. One of the most important indicators of automobile traffic is the degree of its impact on the environment and public health. In this article, using the example of several most typical scenarios of traffic regulation, the degree of automobile traffic influence on the public health risk indicators is shown. Provides environmental assessment of such RTM measures, as the traffic congestion elimination, the narrowing car roadway with the vacant lanes for non-motorized transport (NMT) movement organization, the ban on heavy cars movement, the ban on the movement of vehicles low then a third ecological class on this street section. For this purpose, based on the assessment of gross pollutant emissions by the traffic flow with the specified traffic characteristics and composition, determined using ITS, the average annual surface concentrations of pollutants on adjacent territory and the population health risks are determined. It was found that the greatest environmental effect is caused by measures to organize the NMT movement and the ban on a movement of low environmental classes vehicles.

articleTitle: The Method of Forming a Panorama with Increased Resolution in the Spatial Direction
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The creation of one panorama from several images is today a popular user application in modern multimedia devices. Now, existing stitching methods strive to ensure maximum visual quality, while the algorithms allow the appearance of unreliable objects, such as additional lines and distorted proportions, which entails the loss of information. The task of the proposed method is to maximize the number of pixels in the original images. This gives advantages in the subsequent analysis of the merged images in areas such as security, pattern recognition, etc. In this paper, we present a method for forming a panorama with an increased resolution in the spatial direction with the possibility of a wide basis for the location of electrooptical converters for video analysis from moving platforms. Our method connects the pixel coordinates of the two images using graphs to optimally find the seam boundaries. An algorithm has also been developed to calculate a consistent alignment of overlapping frames.

articleTitle: The Implementation of the Algorithm of "Gluing" Images
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of a prototype of a software package for "gluing" images of various types. The original algorithm and its software implementation are proposed. The technology of data processing when "gluing" images is considered. Experimental studies of the results for different types of images were carried out.

articleTitle: Parameters and Properties of Digital Signal Receivers with a Large Dynamic Range
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The analysis of the relationship between the dynamic range of the digital signal receiver, pass-band, channel throughput and information reproduction accuracy indicators has been carried out. The problem is solved by deriving analytical dependencies based on the Shannon - Hartley theorem, as well as well-known postulates of the theory of radio circuits and signals. The study of analytical relations reveals limitations on the choice of communication channel parameters.

articleTitle: Ultra Wide Band Four Ridge Metal- Dielectric Feed Horn
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An ultra wide band two polarizations four ridge conical metal-dielectric feed horn has been proposed and investigated. The horn has a three-layer dielectric filling and is excited by a circular metal-dielectric waveguide, which is excited by two orthogonally located coaxial lines. Electrodynamic modeling and optimization of horn parameters were carried out using finite element and finite difference in time domain methods. As a result of numerical simulations it is shown that the optimized feed horn provides a reflection coefficient below -15 dB, a stable beamwidth (56°) at the level of -10 to -15 dB, and a stable position of the phase center in the 85% frequency band.

articleTitle: Software and Hardware for Carrying Out Research Work with an Ultra-Short Pulse Probing Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Separate units of the experimental stand have been developed to study the characteristics of objects during remote sensing with ultra-short video pulses without high-frequency filling. The stand includes broadband receiving and transmitting antennas, a wideband multichannel oscilloscope, a personal computer, and synchronization signal generation circuits. The described system can be used for educational, research purposes, to develop techniques and test new approaches to the development of systems of this type, as well as to study the propagation of ultra-short pulse signals in various environments, to detect stationary objects against the background of interfering reflections, and to detect moving objects. The paper presents a general structural diagram of the stand, simulation results and measured characteristics of individual units, a brief overview of the existing system units. The results of a trial run of the system are presented and further plans for carrying out experimental work are indicated.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Electrodynamic Characteristics of a Three-Gap Klystron Resonator with a Strip Line on a Suspended Dielectric Substrate
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article presents the design of a small-sized three-gap rectangular resonator with a suspended dielectric substrate and a two-sided strip line located on it for a low-voltage amplifying klystron C and X wavelength range. Its main electrodynamic and electronic parameters were calculated for anti-phased (4.7 GHz) and in-phased (9.67 GHz) modes of oscillation. It is showed by simulation results that the three-gap rectangular resonator can be tuned to multiples resonant frequency, which makes it possible to operate as a frequency multiplier.

articleTitle: Multi-Station Access Based on Signals with Non-Harmonic Subcarriers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A variant of multi-station access based on Spread Spectrum Signals (SSS) with multiphase non-harmonic subcarriers modulated using pseudorandom sequences (PRSs) that provide a direct extension of their spectrum is considered. It is shown that in this case partial frequency-code compaction of signals is provided. In this case, the main PRS provides a direct expansion of the signal spectrum, and the sub-carrier PRS-on the contrary, its narrowing and localization in the frequency domain. The paper considers a variant of channel information encoding when increasing the distance between the points of the information signal constellation when transmitting its closest points on different subcarriers of the PRS, which allows increasing the bandwidth of the communication channel. In addition, the narrowing of the main correlation peak of the synchro-signal, compared with the case of transmission only to the main PRS (without a subcarrier), will improve the accuracy of synchronization and positioning.

articleTitle: The Research of Digital Antenna Arrays with Directive Radiators for Interference and Noise Cancellation in Azimuth and Elevation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the paper the problem of applying the digital antenna arrays (DAA) equipped with the directional radiators is considered simultaneously on azimuth and elevation planes. The method MUSIC of direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation is researched depending on the shape of the antenna array and the directivity of an individual element. The half-dodecahedron, planar and cylindrical antenna arrays are considered. As it is well known along with DOA-estimation as the first step the beamforming is highly needed at the final stage of the digital arrays functionality. The optimal algorithm of maximizing the ratio of the useful signal to interference + noise (SNIR) is researched in the tasks of the radiation pattern formation simultaneously on azimuth and elevation planes. The estimations of the signal to noise and interference ratio as well as bit error rate (BER) are obtained depending on the directivity of the emitters. The research has established that the shape of the radiation pattern of elements has a significant impact on both the accuracy of bearings and placing the main lobe and zeros. The curves are provided showing the optimal performance of DAA on azimuth and elevation planes.

articleTitle: Methodology for Calculating the Mass of a Vehicle in Dynamics using a Discrete Piezoelectric Sensor in Automatic Weight and Dimensional Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The technique of calculation of vehicle weight with the use of discrete piezoelectric sensor for automatic weight and dimensional control systems of vehicles, allowing to make calculations with the least errors in comparison with the existing monocrystal analogues, is presented. Improving the accuracy of measurements is necessary to improve the quality of the procedure for assessing the physical characteristics of the vehicle at the points of automatic weight and dimensional control.

Author Keywords: Automatic weight and dimensional control systems
Calculation of vehicle weight in dynamics

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Antenna Aperture Based on Short-Pulse Short-Range Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the application of an aperture synthesis algorithm based on a short-pulse radar. Due to the modern element base, it has become possible to create small-sized broadband radars, and the placement of this device on unmanned aerial vehicles opens up opportunities for observing a small area of with a detailed resolution. The device uses a short-pulse probe signal to obtain a wide spectrum of the reflected signal. The short duration, and as a consequence, the wide spectrum of the reflected signal, allow providing high range resolution and stable operation of the radar in conditions of multiple reflections from local objects. To increase the image quality, an algorithm for increasing the azimuth resolution using aperture synthesis is used.

Author Keywords: determining the coordinates of the target

articleTitle: Methodology of Design High Heat Flux for On-Board Radars of Small-Sized Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The methodology is intended to solve the problem of the layout solutions' optimisation of high heat flux on-board radars' structures of small-sized aircraft forced air cooling systems with a limited air flow. The methodology is characterized by a systematic approach and includes solving the external and internal problem of providing the normal thermal regime of the airborne radar structure via optimizing its layout solutions at the early stages of design. The solution of the external problem is the determination of the permissible aerodynamic drag of the structure, with a restriction on the cooling air flow. The solution of the internal problem is the determination of the optimal layout design. The optimisation criteria is the minimum temperature of the airborne radar components, with a restriction on the aerodynamic drag. The field of application of the results obtained is the systems of forced air cooling of electronic devices and devices operating under conditions of a limited flow of cooling air.

articleTitle: Techniques for IPTV Network Quality Assessment by BER Coefficient without Disabling TV Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The method of assessing the quality of the physical data channel in the IPTV system with an industrial streamer encoder by the BER coefficient in the TV broadcasting mode, as well as the method and device implementing the automatic maintenance of the optimal operation of IPTV, not allowing technical stops and even short-term deterioration of image quality in the digital television broadcasting are considered. Receiving and processing the information from the parameter sensors, data rate meter and bit error rate converter is carried out in the multichannel indicator receiver.

articleTitle: Weight Model for Image Compression Method
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, an image compression method based on a weight model was proposed, which allows one to estimate the significance of the detailing coefficients of the orthogonal multiple-scale wavelet transform in terms of their contribution to the total image energy. The method presupposes the decomposition of the original image into a given number of levels, construction of significance maps for the detailing coefficients of each level, and coding of the significant coefficients. The proposed method also allows for progressive compression and restoration of images, as well as for the possible parallel software and hardware implementation. The latter is of great practical importance for reducing the time spent on image analysis and making control decisions in the systems operating in real time. The software implementation of the proposed method in a high-level language is described, which made it possible to reduce the volume of standard test halftone images by at least six times.

articleTitle: Prospects of Implementation of Automated Monitoring Systems, Transportation Forecasting and Robotic Municipal Solid Waste Sorting Points
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article presents the current problems related to optimization of MSW (municipal solid waste) transportation and sorting. The relevance of this topic in the modern world is at the highest level, the amount of garbage is growing, and territories are limited, which leads to the issue of waste recycling. One of the modern technologies for automation of waste recycling plants was considered. And also, the economic aspect of processing, with the possibility of excluding a person from the process of monitoring the performance of the technological process.

articleTitle: Symbol Synchronizers in High-Speed Adaptive Receivers of Optical and Radio Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: When developing modern high-speed receivers, the problem of designing high-speed symbol synchronization systems is quite urgent. Usually these are open-loop systems, built according to the Feedforward algorithm without using additional synchronizing pulses (blind receiver). In this paper, a structural diagram of such an adaptive device for symbol synchronization is drawn up, algorithms for the functioning of its main blocks are selected and described: the block for determining the symbol frequency, the block for estimating and correcting the temporal position of the sample and the decimator. Simulation of signal processing in the digital part of a high-speed optical signal receiver with an information transmission rate of 100 Gbit/s, using DP-QPSK modulation and coding of each transmitted frame in accordance with the OTH hierarchy using standard FECs with different redundancy. Simulation confirmed the correct operation of the synchronization device and made it possible to obtain numerical indicators of the normalized synchronization error depending on the bit signal-to-noise ratio and the number of samples used. Based on the simulation results, it has been proven that the investigated symbol synchronization device retains its operability up to the signal-to-noise ratio of 10 dB. This is sufficient to provide a bit error rate of less than 10–3 even when using low position digital modulation without applying error correction coding.

Author Keywords: scheme for estimating and correcting the temporal position of the sample

articleTitle: The Application of Correlation Analysis in Recognizing Voice Messages in Civil Aviation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers the problem of recognition of voice messages (VM) of phraseological radio exchange in civil aviation (CA). The introduction substantiates the relevance of this problem. The following text describes research methods based on correlation analysis. Finally, a description of the experiment and the results of the operation of recognition algorithms based on correlation analysis are given. In the case of information analysis without artificially generated noise, the probability of correct recognition for a test sample of 100 phrases, 20 for each phrase, was 100%.

articleTitle: A Sustainable Transportation Strategy for Everyday Mobility in Major Regional Centers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The prevalence of individual automobile transportation is one of the most difficult problems of urban transportation today. In order to develop cities sustainably, preserve individual mobility and maintain an acceptable social environment, it is necessary to consider the many disadvantages of the existing transportation system. Constant congestion on the streets, pollution, high mortality due to traffic accidents are all the result of the spontaneous development of urban transportation systems. V ologda, the administrative center of the Vologda region of the Russian Federation, has a population of over 310,000 people and is a typical regional center. Transportation of the population by individual cars accounts for about 84%, while public transport provides only about 11%. Legislative measures by central authorities and the regional government aimed at reducing the use of individual cars and encouraging the switch to public transport and non-motorized modes of transport (walking, cycling, scooter, rollerblading) are not yielding the expected results. To answer the question "why the shift to public transportation and non-motorized modes of transportation has not been widespread," this article presents models and modeling scenarios with a focus on compatibility with everyday mobility. In terms of social mobility, modeling contributes to a better understanding of the reasons for choosing a mode of transportation in the daily mobility of various categories of people in Vologda, explaining the reasons and obstacles to switching to non-motorized modes of transportation and public transportation for various types of travel. Finally, the purpose of this paper is also to create a model for urban mobility analysis, mode selection, and computational modeling scenarios specifically for Vologda, which will serve as a good reference for defining sustainable urban transportation policies, reducing pollution, and ensuring a higher quality of life.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Interaction in O-Type Devices with CRL Type Slow-Wave Structures
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper discusses the modeling of the process of interaction in traveling-wave tubes (TWTs) based on “coaxial-radial line”-type (CRL-type) slow-wave structures (SWSs). One of the most important tasks while designing TWTs is to achieve high output power over wide range of frequencies. The aim of this paper is to try to solve this problem by combining the broad passband which is exhibited by spiral SWSs and good heat dissipation of “chain of coupled cavities” -type SWSs. As a result of this work, an algorithm for calculating the characteristics of transparent multi-beam TWT based on the SWS of the CRL-type and a method for designing TWT data have been developed. The calculation of transparent TWT was carried out. The calculation results show that in such TWT the problem of obtaining high power in combination with good heat dissipation can be solved. In addition, the developed program allows designing both transparent and sectioned TWTs.

articleTitle: Development of a Semantic Expert System for Analyzing the Performance of Devices and Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: There is a need to universalize the diagnostic processes of the operability of various radio technical devices and communication systems (RDCS). However, the presence of a wide range of ISSS requires different, sometimes extremely specific, approaches to their diagnosis. In addition, there is no universal method for storing and processing information containing signs of certain malfunctions, deviations in the quality indicators of the RDCS operation, the reasons for their occurrence and how to eliminate them. It is proposed to solve this problem by using an automated analysis of the quality indicators of the work of the ISSS in the semantic expert system. It will allow you to flexibly associate any indicator of the quality of the RDCS with the cause that influenced it, as well as to link the latter with the method or methods of eliminating the cause, which will provide the proposed algorithmic and software with the opportunity to accumulate knowledge in the field of performance analysis and act as an expert in the process of diagnosing the RDCS.

articleTitle: The Research of Neural Network Architectures for Cardio-Analysis in the Driver Support System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes the development and training of a neural network model for recognizing diseases by cardiogram in application to driver support systems. The network is trained on the data set of The China Physiological Signal Challenge 2018, which includes rhythms that indicate conditions in which the driver may lose control of the vehicle. The architecture of the residual neural network was chosen for the study. The network with 7 residual blocks showed an accuracy of 90% or more for six of the seven classes. One of the classes was recognized with 79% accuracy, which is the minimum recognition accuracy for this network. To increase the accuracy of the network, the number of residual blocks was increased to 10. The new network showed a lower recognition result. Five of the seven classes were recognized with an accuracy of more than 90%, but the minimum accuracy of recognition has become 71%. Where were made the conclusions about the inexpediency of increasing the residual blocks and the need to use a complete set of data to increase the accuracy of the network.

articleTitle: The Principle of Unbundling During Thermal Engineering Calculations of On-Board Digital Signal Processing Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the possibility of applying the principle of unbundling in the thermal calculations of onboard signal processing devices. It is established that when performing such calculations, the problem of large time expenditures inevitably arises, as well as the need for a large number of system resources. The estimation of machine time and system resources costs is made in the case of splitting a General task into a number of subtasks on the principle of unbundling. A method is proposed for moving from lower-level tasks to higher-level tasks, taking into account the docking parameters. The estimation of saving of machine time and system resources costs is made when using the proposed principle of unbundling.

articleTitle: International Training Programs IT Security System for Specialists in Onboard Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The relevance of the research topic of this article is due to the fact that the problem of developing and implementing distance learning technologies in the field of higher education is particularly acute for the Russian education system due to increasing requirements for the quality, volume and pace of the educational process and dissatisfaction with the existing system of higher education. The primary task in the process of implementation and functioning of distance learning mechanisms is to ensure information security. The authors developed models and processes of activities related to distance learning at the University. The problems of information protection in the developed models are solved using the most modern technologies and approaches. An important aspect of the educational activity of a modern University is the implementation of training programs with the possibility of obtaining two state diplomas. Such programs involve training in internal or external exchange, and widely use remote technologies.

articleTitle: Spline Signal Generators for a Given Form on Continual Processors
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the use of continuous processors to generate analog signals of a given shape in a continuous time interval. The purpose of the development is to create built-in devices for monitoring signal parameters for radio engineering systems. The main element of the generator is an analog function interpolator controlled by continuous processors. The generator's operation is based on the approximation of signal functions by its tabulated values. The signal is synthesized at conjugate time intervals by the method of forming a spline model of the function. To calculate the spline coordinates, the polynomials of Newton, Bessel and Stirling are used. The proposed approach makes it possible to create small-sized devices for synthesizing signals of a given shape using analog elements.

articleTitle: Methodology for Reducing the Number of Psychological Test Questions for Use in a Predictive Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes an approach to reducing the number of questions in the Keys to Personal Mastery Inventory (KPMI) psychological testing questionnaire with the further addition of missing data and their use in a machine learning model to predict respondent satisfaction with their job. Since the 30s of the 20th century, mathematicians, physicists and engineers have been working on the description of traffic flows. But theoretical models do not work well because a person is driving a car, and a person is unpredictable. In the same situation, it behaves differently. This work aims to reduce driver uncertainty using machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Scientific Support of Temporary Highways (Winter Roads) Operation Processes in the Russia Arctic Zone
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Nowadays, research activities of some countries in northern polar region of the Earth have intensified in the world. Various international scientific Arctic programs have revived, in which Russia, the United States and Canada hold key positions. This interest is primarily due to the rich resources of these territories - oil, gas condensate, mineral. Accelerated development of the Arctic, including coast and shelf of Arctic seas, which is a condition for enhancing Russia's economic potential, means intensive territory development with creation of appropriate infrastructure, transport and communications. At the same time, extreme climatic, difficult mining and geological and extremely unfavorable socio-economic conditions must be taken into account.

Author Keywords: digital model of temporary highway route

articleTitle: The Method of the Synthesis of the Optimal Design Solution of Radio Electronic System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The method of designing structures of radio-electronic devices with a modular structure is considered. This method includes a sequence of the following design stages: structural synthesis of alternative design solutions; parametric synthesis of design solutions; definitions of admissible design solutions that meet the requirements of the technical task; choice of an optimal variant of a constructive design solution. The implementation of structural and parametric synthesis is carried out by using the mathematical apparatus of multipartite graphs. Determination of admissible design solutions and the choice of the optimal variant is implemented using artificial intelligence method, which is implemented on the basis of a multilayer perceptron. This method allows to classify alternative design solutions according to a complex parameter. The set possible alternative design solutions are divided into two classes - admissible and not admissible design solutions. The choice of the optimal variant is carried out by ranking the values of complex parameters included in the range of acceptable values, and determining the design solution that best meets the specified requirements. This method allows to choose the design solution with the maximum possible use of ready-made modules. This makes it possible to reduce the time and cost of designing a new device.

articleTitle: Method of Receiving-Transmitting Module Testability for Radar with Active Electronically Scanned Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The principle of monitoring the technical state and the structure of a receiving-transmitting module with a closed loop of end-to-end verification of the transmitting and receiving channels by branching the signal from the output of the transmitting channel to the input of the receiving channel in the time interval when the reflected signal is not received are proposed. The advantages, disadvantages and limitations of alternative options for organizing end-to-end test monitoring from the input to the output of transceiver module of an active electronically scanned array due to the use of passive and active elements in the control loop are shown.

articleTitle: Multifactorial methodology of cycling routes time calculation based on 3D maps
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern sports tourism is being transformed under the influence of world tourism trends. The creation of clear and convenient routes will allow for more organized tourism activities and reduce the chaotic load on the natural environment. Based on the analysis of applications for planning and tracking routes, the article proposes a multifactor method for calculating time, which allows you to develop clear and well-constructed tourist routes and solve specific problems, including taking into account weather conditions, terrain and various categories of participants. This article focuses on the methodology for calculating the time of passage of multi-day cycling routes in three main categories: mountainous terrain, flat terrain with water obstacles and a route crossing the state border. The proposed methodology solves the problem of symbiosis between geography and tourism practice.

articleTitle: Determining Shortest Paths between Two Arbitrary Nodes in a Composite Transport Network Using Segment Routing
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The task of finding the optimal shortest path is a key task in routing, and new drivers of the development of data transmission technologies require improvements in devices, services and technologies, in particular, in order to adapt existing algorithms and methods for finding shortest paths for segment routing problems. In this case, the key element of determining the shortest path is the metric. Since determining the shortest paths is an important step in forming a composite path within segment routing, determining the correct metric has a strong impact on this process. Segment routing represents an important evolutionary step forward in the design, management and operation of modern transport networks, including the global Internet. This paper considers the possibility of determining the optimal paths between two arbitrary nodes in a composite network using the segment routing methodology. Discusses the relevance of the problem, the issues of determining the minimum path weight, the path with the minimum weight, achieving the minimum delay, determination of the shortest path with segmentation and the problem of the minimum delay path in the segment routing.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Network Traffic Generators and Classifiers Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: We introduce a neural network framework that allows constructing multi-class network traffic models suitable for flow generation and classification tasks. Packet size and inter-packet time sequences were the only flow features that formed the inputs.
