Our approach has two main components: a packet feature quantizer and a sequence model, which we verified on example configuration with K-Means algorithm and Transformer-based models respectively. Moreover, we claim a possibility of knowledge transfer from the generation to the classification task. The evaluation of the generator's traffic quality was carried out by means of Kolmogorov-Smirnov metric for such parameters as packet size, inter-arrival time, throughput and number of packets per flow in directions to and from traffic origin. The results showed that the proposed multi-class model performed on par with individual single-class Markov-based models. As for the classification task, the model outperformed FS-NET and a conventional Random Forest classifier. We demonstrated that performing the knowledge transfer procedure between traffic generator and classifier (so-called generative pretraining) could improve performance on the traffic classification task even further. We also release the code, datasets and trained models.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Building a Cluster for Implementing the “Memory as a Service” Service in the IoT Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In the next 5 years, the total amount of data transmitted from devices is likely to exceed the limit of 160 zettabytes, which is more than 3 times higher than the current value. As the volume of information increases, the volume of traffic also increases, so the possibility of maintaining a stable network operation is seen in the further deepening of virtualization, the transition from cloud to foggy computing and dew computing. The introduction of fog computing technology leads to changes in the algorithms of information transmission, processing and storage technologies, which allows users to receive new types of services at a new level, and the main scope of fog computing technology is the Internet of things. This paper examines the issues of building a cluster model designed for one of the types of boundary computing - the concept of dew computing. It involves user interaction with an electronic device, including the emergence of a new concept based on the emergence of an environment in which it is possible to lease memory on a device owned by another user-memory as a service.

articleTitle: To the Matter of Implementation of Radio Engineering Data Transmission System with APSK-N-signal based on the Theory of Resolution Time
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper is dedicated to solution the problem related to the practical implementation of a radio engineering data transmission system which is based on the theory of resolution time, in which amplitude-phase shift signals with N discrete signals are used. In this work, analytical expressions are obtained that allow taking into account the instability of the initial phase of the carrier of information signal when choosing a configuration of signal constellation. Block diagram for considered type ReDTS is presented. The selection data transmission algorithm is presented.

articleTitle: Using Probabilistic Methods in the Analysis of Information Security of Distributed Ledger Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, using probabilistic methods of the queuing theory for blockchain-based distributed ledger systems mathematical models are constructed that allow calculating a number of characteristics of these systems. The obtained mathematical models are intended for private blockchains and can be used to analyze and optimize the operation of distributed ledger systems in order to ensure their information security.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Spectral and Hierarchy Analysis Methods Applicability for Technical Systems Choosing
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the fundamental features of the application of the decision support system on the example of solving the problem of planning the process of managing technical systems of wireless access to Enterprise Infocommunication Network. The purpose of this article is to consider approaches to the automatic selection of the optimal technical solution for promising business and technological process management systems based on the methods of spectral analysis and analysis of hierarchies. The system analysis technique is developed and applied if the decision-maker does not have the necessary information about a certain situation, allowing it to formalize and find a solution to the problem. Decision-making in management activities is based on a specific type of intellectual activity - information and analytical activities, as a set of activities for the search, collection, processing of information, its assessment, analysis and forecasting of the state of the control object. The importance of information and analytical activities in modern conditions is sharply increasing due to the following reasons: a sharp increase in the volume of information processed in the course of decision-making on management; the difficulty of identifying and establishing cause-and-effect relationships in information about the existing area of management; the complexity of process automation in advanced business and technological process management systems. This necessitates the creation within the framework of a promising automated control system of its specific part - a decision support system. The proposed method of Spectral Analysis Method and the Hierarchy Analysis Method of automatic selection of the optimal technical solution for promising control systems allows automating the process of evaluating the effectiveness and choosing the optimal technical system, in particular, choosing the most optimal means of wireless access to the corporate infocommunication network.

articleTitle: V2X-based Intersection Priority Management
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the most difficult problems of today's transport system is the management of intersections in large cities. Standard methods and automated control systems based on them through traffic lights are efficient, but not able to cope with certain problems related to galloping mobility. However, modern advances in cooperative communication and navigation have made joint intersection management possible, in which road users and roadside infrastructure can coordinate traffic effectively. This paper proposes a new-proposal approach to intersection priority management under the gradual penetration of Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) technology.

articleTitle: The Modeling of Elastic Traffic Transmisson by the Mobile Network with NB-IoT Functionality
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The development of the concept of the Internet of Things (loT) and the use of existing mobile networks for organizing machine-to-machine communication networks require new approaches to planning a network resource. The most popular solution in this area is NB-IoT (Narrow Band Internet of Things), a mobile communication standard for telemetry devices with low communication volumes. This paper investigates a case of network slicing and processor sharing (PS) service policy using in mobile network with batched arrival of requests from smart objects. The mathematical model of the corresponding model is corresponding system is built. Markov process that describes model function is constructed. The numerical results are presented that illustrate the solution of three different problems of planning network resource using the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Estimation of Contact Center Performance Measures in Case of Overload and Chatbot Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Chatbots are natural virtual language assistants based on the artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning. Chatbots' popularity is increasing quickly nowadays. They are used for providing real-time service and implemented in the different customer support systems. Today, chatbots are used to improve customer experience in contact centers. Chatbots facilitates on-line conversations via text or text-to-speech. One of the most important problems is call center overload, and to determine the optimal number of agents required for the customer servicing in system where chatbots are used for handling similar requests from the customers. This paper analyzes the mathematical model of a contact-center with two types of customer service - chatbots and agents. Markov process that describes model function is constructed. Vital performance measures of interest are defined through the values of stationary probabilities of model states. Algorithm of characteristics estimation is suggested based on solving the system of state equations. The numerical assessment is given; the positive effect of chatbot usage for elimination of overload is shown. The constructed model and elaborated algorithms of performance measure estimation can be used for the control of contact center functioning in case of overload.

articleTitle: A Methodology for Optimizing the Objective Function in a High-dimensional Space Using the Swarm Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A formal definition of the particle swarm method and the software algorithm based on it is given. The influence of the algorithm parameters on the global minimum search efficiency is studied using the example of a multiparameter function. The best parameters that allow achieving an average error from 0.05 % for a two-parameter function to 0.13 % for a function with 5 parameters are determined. It is found that increasing the swarm size and applying an increased number of iterations in a single numerical calculation are not the most effective means of increasing accuracy. It is shown that several sequential independent calculations, from the results of which the best one is selected, make the most sense. In this case, the required error of up to 1 % was guaranteed to be achieved by using 3 sequential calculations with a swarm size of 15 particles and 500 iterations on each calculation. High-precision calculations with an error of no more than 0.1 % required 10 sequential calculations with a swarm size of 30 particles and 1000 iterations in the calculation, the total amount of computational work was 0.3 million conditional iterations. When using a single calculation, an error of 0.13 % was achieved when performing at least 1.25 million conditional iterations.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Instantaneous Frequency and Envelope of CFSKn-n-Signal in the Channel with Memory
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is dedicated to the study of peculiarities of the behavior of the envelope and instantaneous frequency of the CFSK-n-signal at the output of channel with memory caused by it frequency selective properties. New properties and phenomena are revealed that allow to increase the efficiency of communication systems with this type of signals, built on the basis of the theory of resolution time.

articleTitle: Two-Frequency Reflectometric Initialization of the Upstream Central Wavelength in Transport WDM-PON Domain for 5G Mobile Radio Access Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Tuning the wavelength of a colorless laser transmitter, used to build an upstream channel in the WDM-PON transport domain of a 5G mobile radio access network, to the wavelength of the maximum transmission of its multiplexer channel is implemented by a number of regulated and proactive procedures. The first include the procedures associated with the construction of the AMCC control and management channel, regulated by the ITU-T G.989.3 recommendation. The second is the construction of systems with probing of the complete structure of the ascending channel of the pass and reflective types. The main attention in the article will be paid to the consideration of reflective type systems. Broadband and single-frequency reflective methods for tuning direct modulation lasers: VSCEL, DFB, DBR, and external modulation lasers: integral module on InP-substrate, with direct detection and heterodyne reception are analyzed, their advantages and disadvantages are determined. The transition to modulation reflectometric methods of tuning is substantiated, for which one-, two- and three-frequency technologies for multiplexer probing based on EML lasers with scanning are proposed. The use of both latter methods makes it possible to increase the signal-to-noise ratio, sensitivity and accuracy of multiplexer spectral characteristics measurements, and, consequently, the accuracy of tuning the wavelength of a colorless laser transmitter to the central wavelength of one of multiplexer channels.

Author Keywords: passive optical transport domain with wavelength division multiplexing

articleTitle: About One Cloud Computing Simulation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Today, the use of cloud resources is becoming increasingly popular. On the one hand, it is mere data storage and their respective sharing by a number of users, on the other hand, it is the opportunities that open up following large computing resources available “in the cloud”. An important aspect is the hash function search technologies and adjusting approaches to managing computing resources due to the specifics of their service algorithms. The article considers a simulation model for a computational process built in the Simulink environment (SimEvent) and based on the queueing theory of a G/G/n/inf. system with a set of input streams, an infinite queue, two feedbacks formed by re-processing a request in case of a device failure, and because of the possibility of an extranonce situation and its handling. The results of modeling are considered for different input flows - deterministic, uniformly distributed, Poisson and exponential, with different service disciplines and different laws of processing requests in the queue. The advantages and disadvantages of the proposed model are analyzed in comparison with the well-known methods of controlling input streams (scheduling tasks in operating systems).

articleTitle: Information and Reference Systems in Corporate Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: There is a rapid development of means of fixed and mobile user access to reference and information services. Multimedia communication services are in demand. Accordingly, the functionality of call service centers is expanding. We will discuss improvements in call recognition and distribution. Solutions for the organization of robotic systems are proposed. Software developers take into account the wishes of customers of commercial structures and the special requirements of law enforcement and public safety authorities. Using the example of Asterisk or Naumen Contact Center, we will determine the prospects for the development of call service centers of commercial structures. Outsourcing options considered. Let us discuss the peculiarities of servicing emergency calls in the centralized “System 112”. Operators of “System 112” service transit traffic by issuing electronic notification of incidents. Several emergency services (for example, police, firefighters, ambulance) will receive information about serious emergencies from the operators of the “Service 112”. Let us discuss the tendency of organizing a single call-center in distributed corporate communication networks using a specific example, when calls can come from users of different regions of Russia - Central Russia, Siberia, Far East region. The organization of such a center involves the use of the distance factor. Supervisors organize day and night shifts for operators. An example of calculating the resources of such a center is considered. The creation of large call service centers in the South- West Siberia region is possible with the involvement of satellite communications resources.

articleTitle: The Concept of a Multi-Beam Radar in the Smart City Air Traffic Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article provides insight into the technical implementation and characteristics of a multi-beam surveillance radar designed to work as part of the small-sized unmanned aerial vehicle traffic control complex in a “smart city”. In the article, it is pointed out that the advantages of this type of radar are a long range, resistance to weather conditions, quick changeover of the frame in a wide scanning area. The proposed technical concept is the one of the radar, which provides detecting drones at a range of up to 10 km. The description includes the design of the receiving phased array antenna and the structure of the receiving channel. The requirements for the dynamic range of the receiver are well justified, and the need to use automatic gain time control to expand the scan area in the range is clearly illustrated. The required parameters and characteristics of the equipment mainly correspond to the existing models of survey radars and the models being developed and are quite achievable with a modern technical base. The article presents characteristics of a multi-beam radar experimental sample and the results of its tests at observing drones. The tests have proven the predicted characteristics, and demonstrated the ability to effectively suppress reflections from the ground, as well as gave credence to the calculated detection range parameters and the strong immunity of the radar to bad weather conditions. The materials provided in the article are supported with the radar images received in course of the experiments.

articleTitle: Transforming the Structure of Spectrally Effective Radio Signals for Amplification in Nonlinear Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses signals with amplitude-phase modulation used in special-purpose communication networks. A description of the transformation of the structure of spectrally effective radio signals for amplification in nonlinear power amplifiers is given and the element base for its implementation is considered. Simulation of the application of the transformation of the signal structure in the baseband for nonlinear amplification of spectrally effective narrowband radio signals is carried out.

articleTitle: Symmetrical Optical Vector Analysis for High-Q Structures Based on Tandem Amplitude-Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A symmetric optical vector analysis (OVA) based on amplitude-phase dual-band modulation with suppression of an optical carrier is proposed and numerically simulated. Accurate and stable frequency characteristics are achieved in it by the formation and minimization of such higher-order components in the probe radiation, the difference frequency of which does not coincide with the difference frequency of the two main first-order measuring components. Obtained high-quality characteristics were confirmed by numerical simulation of the developed OVA when analyzing the spectral parameters of an ultra-narrow-band fiber Bragg grating. The presented method is structurally simple, does not require the use of various generators to perform its main functions and monitoring functions, and can be used to characterize both selective fiber-optic structures and high-Q optical Fabry-Perot resonators, ring resonators of active and passive type, transparency windows of nonlinear crystals, etc.

Author Keywords: optical high-Q structures of symmetric type
selective fiber-optic filters and Bragg-type sensors
amplitude-phase modulation formation of a two-frequency symmetric probe radiation from a single-frequency optical carrier with its complete suppression

articleTitle: Simulation of Spatial Correlation of Polarization Characteristics for Meteor Radio Reflections
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper relates to a spatial correlation of polarization characteristics of radio waves scattered from ionized meteor trails. The accurate modeling of polarization of meteor radio reflections is achieved through a separate consideration of oblique diffraction on meteor trails of both the longitudinal and the transverse components of the electric field of incident radio waves. The Faraday polarization twist due to propagation in the ionosphere is also taken into account. By a computer simulation of two typical meteor radio links, we assess a correlation between the polarizations of the radio reflections received at two separate antennas spaced at various distances and along various azimuth directions. It is shown that, in some cases, a coherence radius of the polarization characteristics may exceed 100 km, and its main limiting factor is an inhomogeneity of scattering properties along the meteor trail. The obtained spatial correlation curves are crucial for assessing secrecy of the shared encryption keys generated from the measurements of random polarizations of meteor radio reflections. Our estimates reveal a certain vulnerability of the polarization-based key generation systems to the channel eavesdropping.

articleTitle: Physicochemical Method of Organizing Boundary and Hydrodynamic Lubrication in Friction Units
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper shows the prospects of using nanotechnologies for increasing the reliability of agricultural machinery. The authors present technologies of applying a monomolecular protective film on the friction unit surfaces and the experimental results of their effectiveness under conditions of boundary and hydrodynamic friction.

articleTitle: Calorimetric Method for Measurement of Electrically Small Antennas Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: To solve the problem of measuring the efficiency of electrically small portable and mobile antennas operating at HF and MF ranges, a calorimetric measurement method is considered. The method is based on the representation of the antenna as a physical system in which electromagnetic radiation is useful, and heat losses are detrimental. Measuring the heat loss of the antenna and its non-radiating equivalent allows you to estimate the efficiency. The description of the developed calorimetric installation for measuring the efficiency is given. Physical and technical features of its work are considered. For testing, a sample of a small-sized spiral antenna was selected, operating at a frequency of 1.9 MHz and matched with a 50 Ohm feedline with VSWR <; 1.1; the efficiency measurement was carried out, which showed the high efficiency of the antenna being measured.

articleTitle: Organization of Effective Functioning of the Information Subsystem of a Network of Distributed Heterogeneous Information and Computing Resources
publicationTitle: 2021 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: As a rule, the management of complex organizational-technical facilities is implemented through the creation of automated control systems, and to ensure continuity and maintain the required level of the quality management system of the automated control system provides information subsystem, which provides officials control and automation systems providing the required item of information services that guarantee make informed correct decisions for the organization management system. At the same time, the functioning of the information subsystem itself as a complex system, including in emergency conditions, provides for its management, for which a dedicated management system is created, which is assigned to solve a number of management tasks, among which the most important is the task of ensuring effective functioning, including on the basis of creating and implementing methods for managing the processes of providing information services. At the same time, the constantly increasing complexity of information subsystems and their functioning processes makes it extremely difficult to organize the management processes of the subsystem itself. Among all the tasks of managing an information subsystem, the task of managing its functioning is the most complex, since it is associated with the need to take into account many factors, characteristics and parameters of complex processes occurring in the subsystem. Therefore, when developing methods of management of functioning of the information subsystem, it is advisable to consider the control problem as a complex, involving the application of complex methods, each of which is used in the control loop of the control system under certain operating conditions and provides either the highest efficiency or efficiency not lower than required.

Author Keywords: methods of managing the processes of providing services
